articleTitle: Polyp-YOLOv5-Tiny: A Lightweight Model for Real-Time Polyp Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Early colonoscopy diagnosis can significantly reduce the mortality rate of colon cancer patients. Deep learning based object detection assists to enhance clinical performance on accurate diagnosis; however, it is challenging to integrate current object detection models on low-performance endoscope hardware devices. This paper presents a lightweight model for real-time polyp detection. By reducing the number of convolutional kernels by half and removing the large-object-detecting head from YOLOv5, our model got a similar precision to YOLOv3-spp (mAP.5:.95 of 0.591 and 0.583 respectively), but with a model size of only 2.8 MB (119.7 MB of YOLOv3-spp). There is a slight loss in precision compared to YOLOv5s (mAP.5:.95 of 0.636 with 13.7MB model size); however, our model still shows a significant advantage on reducing model complexity. Experimental results also indicated that MS COCO pre-training is helpful in polyp detection tasks, and the Mosaic augmentation strongly enhances the precision of YOLO models especially when the training set is small.

articleTitle: Coal Gangue Recognition Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Coal gangue sorting is an important part of the construction of smart mines. At present, coal gangue identification and detection algorithms are mostly based on laboratory simulations for testing. Under actual working conditions, there are problems such as missed detection and poor real-time performance. In response to this problem, an improved YOLOv5 coal gangue recognition algorithm was proposed, and a live image acquisition system was designed. First, Mosaic data enhancement is used to increase sample diversity, Add attention moudle to improve detection performance, and the camera is mounted for data collection in actual working conditions. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm has an accuracy rate of 95.5%, with high recognition accuracy, and has important reference significance for practical applications.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization Task Offloading Strategy for Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With increase of Internet of Things (IoT) devices, the burden of cloud computing servers is gradually increasing. Mobile Edge Computing (MEC), as an emerging solution, can relieve the pressure of computing and improve the quality of user experience. One of the critical challenges in MEC is to make effective use of communication and computing resources and select the task processing mode reasonably. In this paper, based on the scenario of a single mobile device (MD) to one mobile edge server (MES), we propose a Joint optimization method base on Discrete Binary Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm (JOBPSO) for system load. The JOBPSO can optimize MD's task offloading, reduce delay and energy consumption. Finally, the simulation results indicate that the performance of JOBPSO in reducing system load is better than the other two traditional offloading methods.

articleTitle: Environmental sound classification based on adding noise
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As ESC is widely used in daily life, it has developed rapidly in recent years. Environment sound classification is a type of sound event recognition (SER). Because of the different position between the sound source and the physical medium of collecting information and the interference of many other sound sources in the process of receiving sound, it leads to the confusion and overlapping of sound events and other complex environmental sound. Combined with the characteristics of environmental sound mentioned above, neural network training with typical experience risk minimization is prone to memory of specific individual voice in the training stage, which will lead to unsatisfactory prediction results when predicting data outside the training distribution, that is, the occurrence of over-fitting. In order to solve the problem of low generalization of neural network, this paper started from the data source to explore the effect of adding gaussian white noise and SNR noise into environmental sound, which are two kinds of audio enhancement algorithms, and organized a series of experiments on Urbansoud8K public environmental sound dataset to verify.

articleTitle: Application of logistic regression algorithm in the diagnosis of expression disorder in Parkinson's disease
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a common neurodegenerative disease with low mortality but high disability rate, and the prevalence gradually increases with age. “Hypomimia” is considered to be one of the common symptoms of Parkinson's patients. The patient seldom blinks, his eyes turn less, and his expression is dull. Even if he makes an expression intentionally, he appears very stiff, as if he is wearing a mask. Computer image processing and machine learning help patients discover their disease and obtain treatment in a relatively short period of time. For this reason, based on the Facial Action Coding System (FACS), this paper proposes a diagnosis and evaluation method of Parkinson's disease expression disorder based on facial action units. A quantitative evaluation method of facial expression behavior based on facial action units is proposed. A differential diagnosis model for Parkinson's disease is established. The validity of recognition model is verified.The severity of Hypomimia symptoms is graded. The relationship between facial expression disorder and disease grade in patients is explored. The accuracy of the optimal threshold value of the logistic regression classifier is 90.06%.The results have practical significance and application value for objective diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.

articleTitle: Improved Single Haze Removal Algorithm Based on Color Attenuation Prior
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With continuous development and application of computer vision, images with high clarity and quality are increasingly important in training different kinds of models, especially in the field of automated driving and road safety monitoring. In this paper, through learning on the benchmarking dataset, we propose a novel quadratic model of color attenuation prior to calculate the scene depth map and then obtain the transmission matrix and restore the hazy-free image. Numerous experimental results show that the proposed approach is more accurate on sculpt the correlation between scene brightness, saturation and depth, therefore it outperforms the linear model in terms of both dehazing effect and clarity. Meanwhile, the objective and subjective comparison with the other state-of-the-art algorithms on the hazy images demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on E-Commerce Personalized Recommendation System based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Regarding to the recommendation systems for most e-commerce platforms at this stage, there are some issues such as the single personalized recommendation method and no deeper data analysis. By researching the development background of recommendation systems, domestic and international related research results, recommendation algorithm and its application, and analysis and summary of many e-commerce user behavior data, we propose a personalized recommendation system architecture based on a combination of offline mining, real-time mining, and deep learning technology. After determining the architecture and functions of the system, we started to design the personalized recommendation system in detail. The core idea is to collect and pre-process data in real-time from multiple e-commerce platforms which generate user data and gather all the personalized data of the users to prepare for the next data mining, then use the data mining technology in the big data to recommend personalizing products automatically, so that it can satisfy the personalized requirements of users.

articleTitle: Infrared Image Enhancement Algorithm based on Weighted Guided Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of blurred details and over enhancement in traditional infrared image enhancement algorithms, an infrared image enhancement method based on guided weighted image filtering is proposed. Firstly, the gradient difference between the pixels around the image is used to find the isolated noise and the median filter is used to filter it; Then, the weighted guided image filter is used to decompose the image to obtain the basic component and detail component. The Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) is used to equalize the stretched contrast in the basic layer, and the nonlinear function is used to enhance and suppress the noise in the detail layer; Finally, different levels of results are fused to obtain contrast and detail enhanced infrared images. This method is used to simulate many groups of infrared images of different scenes, and compared with many enhancement methods. The results show that the proposed method has better results in infrared image detail and contrast enhancement.

articleTitle: Path Planning Algorithm on Large Scale Terrain Data Based on PRM with Non-Uniform Sampling Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Path planning is a research hotspot in the field of geographic information. Many scholars research on path planning on road networks, but path planning in areas without road network has not been thoroughly studied. This paper aims to find lower-cost paths quickly on large scale digital terrain data. We proposed a method based on the PRM algorithm which incorporates a non-uniform sampling strategy to increase the possibility to find better paths with fewer sampling points. A post-optimization method is also suggested to optimize the final path. Experiments prove the effectiveness of our algorithm compared to classical PRM with the uniform sampling strategy.

articleTitle: Food Image Recognition Algorithm Base on Improved VGG16
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Being aimed at the problems of difficult feature extraction and low recognition accuracy of oven food image in the existing network model, the improved VGG16 oven food classification method is proposed. This method uses Asymmetric Convolution Block (ACB) to replace the original convolution kernel to improve the performance of the benchmark model and add a Batch Normalization (BN) layer after the pooling layer to enhance standardization. However, due to the problems of high texture similarity, complex background and background interference in oven food image, the attention mechanism is added to the convolution neural network model. Experimental results prove that compared with the traditional neural network the recognition accuracy of this model is improved to 99.2%. The model proposed in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy and applicability of image classification.

articleTitle: Study of hospital emergency resource scheduling based on digital twin technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Emergency resource scheduling is a key process in hospital emergency management. However, due to the uncertainty and fuzziness of hospital emergency resource scheduling, hospital has to face great challenges in emergency management. In order to better implement emergency resource scheduling in hospitals, this paper studies the perception and allocation of emergency resource scheduling based on digital twin perception and virtual reality interaction technology, and expounds the data twin model, medicine packaging recognition process, hospital emergency dispatch mechanism. Our research can effectively help hospitals solve the uncertainty and fuzziness of emergency resource scheduling, which provides a new method for the research of hospital emergency management.

articleTitle: Review of Path Planning Algorithms for Unmanned Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The knowledge of unmanned vehicles path planning algorithm is introduced. Firstly, the basic concept and steps of path planning are described. Secondly, it introduces Dijkstra algorithm, A-Star algorithm, RRT algorithm, PRM algorithm and other typical path planning algorithms from the classification ideas of the path planning algorithm based on search and sampling. The advantages and disadvantages of each algorithm are analyzed, and the applicable environment and conditions of the algorithm are summarized. Finally, several new algorithms and their development directions are introduced.

articleTitle: A Framework for Multi-Event Data Collection Using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Aided Internet of Things in Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, the internet of things (IoT) has developed rapidly. By introducing the technologies of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), IoT has become more flexibility, mobility, and scalability. Therefore, UAV aided IoT is widely applied in smart agriculture for collecting the sensing data, especially for the large planting areas. Although IoT has made great progress in energy consumption, battery, and wireless charging, agricultural IoT is still facing the energy limitation and time constraint because of long time work and heavy load. While with the development of precision agriculture and smart agriculture, these new agricultural paradigms require higher information density data. Furthermore, UAV aided agricultural IoT have to pay more attention to the multi-event priority from data collection layer. Therefore, taking into account the different events with different priorities for the collection data in agricultural IoT, our work proposed a multi-event data collection framework with time constraint for unmanned aerial vehicle aided internet of things in smart agriculture. Firstly, the structure of the framework of UAV aided agricultural IoT for data collection is presented. Secondly, based on the event priority the framework working processing is demonstrated. Finally, a flight path planning strategy is given based on priority of event. The proposed framework of UAV aided IoT has great advantages in collecting data with high information value, will promote the progress of some new agricultural modes such as smart agriculture.

articleTitle: Android Malware Detection Based on Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the current Android malware detection methods have a single feature dimension and it is difficult to determine the multi-dimensional characteristics of the malware, this article proposes an Android malware detection method based on image analysis. This method visualizes the software's DEX file, extracts the shallow texture features and deep abstract features and combines them, and finally uses the Light Gradient Boosting Machine to detect. Experiments show that when using fusion features, the detection accuracy rate reaches 98.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the effect is significantly improved compared with using a single feature.

articleTitle: Detection of the Floating Objects on the Water Surface Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: An improved YOLOv5 surface floating object detection algorithm is proposed to solve the problems of low detection accuracy and slow speed in the detection of floating objects on the water surface. Firstly, the smooth label is introduced to suppress the over-fitting phenomenon in the training process of the network model. Secondly, the inception topology is used to enhance the feature extraction of floating objects, under the premise of ensuring network accuracy, the low number of parameters and the amount of calculation are maintained. Finally, the loss function of YOLOv5 is optimized to improve the speed and accuracy of prediction frame regression. Experimental results show that the improved mean Average Precision (mAP) of YOLOv5 reaches 96.48%, which is 16.9% higher than that of YOLOv5, and the detection rate up to 30fps. This detection strategy is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Modulation recognition of communication signals based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Deep residual shrinkage network was used to realize modulation signals feature extraction and classification recognition according to the characteristics of signals to further improve the accuracy of communication signals modulation recognition under low signal-to-noise ratio. The deep residual shrinkage network can extract feature from noised signals more effectively with the help of soft thresholding under the attention mechanism, and its modulation recognition rate especially under low signal-to-noise ratio compared with convolutional neural network and deep residual network has improved significantly through experiments. The network pruning method was used to optimize the model to improve the training efficiency of the deep residual shrinkage network model. The method effectively compresses and accelerates the model while ensuring that the model still has good recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Research of Transformer Core Grounding Current Monitoring Device On-site Calibration Technology Based on Compensation Current
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Firstly, in view of the fact that the traditional transformer core grounding current monitoring device cannot be accurately monitored due to the nearby magnetic flux leakage interference, this paper puts forward the dual current monitoring technology to filter out the spatial magnetic flux leakage interference and realize the accurate monitoring of grounding current under the strong electromagnetic field interference environment. Then, based on the dual current monitoring technology, the verification method of “empty first and then injection” is proposed, and the field inspection standard device is developed (accuracy=0.5%, response time≤15us), the full-scale inspection of the transformer core grounding current monitoring device under the condition of live operation and non disassembly is realized, which fills the technical gap of live inspection and value traceability after the monitoring device is put into operation.

articleTitle: Track-association Algorithm Based on Fuzzy C-Means Clustering with PSO
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Track-association has been recognized as one of the major problems in distributed multi-sensor information fusion systems. This paper mainly discusses the track-association problem for the distributed multi-target tracking system. A novel fuzzy clustering algorithm which uses PSO algorithm and combines with Fuzzy C-means(FCM) is proposed. And then apply this algorithm in the problem of the track-association. At last, the simulation results under the three sensor environment are given. Compared with the FCM method, the result show it enhances the correct association rate efficiently in the different disturbs environment.

articleTitle: Detect Network Water Army based on Large-scale E-commerce Reviews
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The e-commerce water army research is to detect those water army in the major e-commerce platforms. Most of the existing studies use manual identification of water army to construct datasets, and the models used are too single. This paper proposes an NSR model based on the official labeled real dataset. This model aggregates the three algorithms of Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine and Random Forest through a certain combination strategy, and finally forms a strong learner. Subsequently, a characteristic experiment is carried out on 7 types of personal behavior characteristics of the water army, and the corresponding CDF diagram is drawn to show the ability of each behavior feature to detect water army, thus comparing the performance of the water army and normal users in different dimensions. Finally, the experimental results based on the Yelp dataset show that the NSR model outperforms the other three algorithms in the three indicators of Accuracy, Precision and F1-score.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Delivery Based on UAVs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of economy and the rapid improvement of people's material living standards, e-commerce is booming, and the Courier service industry arises at the right moment.In order to solve the problem of Courier delivery in remote areas, three key factors affecting the delivery of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) were considered, and the coverage model of UAVs was established to realize the full coverage of the delivery points in the target area.Secondly, the UAV distribution model is established to realize the non-repeated cross-distribution of each UAV and achieve the lowest cost and highest efficiency of distribution.Finally, an express delivery in a remote area is taken as an example to verify the results. The research results show that using 3 unmanned aerial vehicles can efficiently deliver to 15 remote distribution points, greatly saving the delivery cost and achieving the optimal delivery result.Therefore, it is feasible to use drones to deliver deliveries in remote areas.

articleTitle: Classification of Common Urinary Pathogens Based on Hyperspectral Microscope Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: All the time, common pathogens in urine have been threatening human health even lives. Though Chromogenic plates is able to detect urinary bacteria, another technique and material need to be introduced for coloration. However, this kind of technique and material is not always specific. Therefore, how to rapidly detect and classify these bacteria is a tricky challenge waiting to be overcome. For solving this problem, we use hyperspectral imaging (HSI) and random forest (RF) to classify four strains of common pathogens in the urinary, which include E.faeca, K.pneum, S.aureu, and S.pneum. HSI is able to obtain spatial and hyperspectral information of the object. RF boosts classifying accuracy by combining many decision trees. Utilizing HSI and RF, we find that these bacteria can be separated well at the cellular level.

articleTitle: Occlusion face detection is based on Yolov5s
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that trains computers to interpret the visual world and humans in a way similar to vision. Due to the rapid development of technology and the relatively small cost of data storage, face detection has developed rapidly in the field of computer vision in the past decade. Among them, face detection and recognition are the most widely used, ranging from mobile applications and augmented reality for entertainment purposes to social networks and security cameras. Most importantly, with the development of face detection technology, the yolov5s model has made great achievements in recent years. Based on the latest and fastest Yolov5s model, this paper uses transfer learning to fine-tune the model parameters to extract facial features. Finally, the MAFA data set is tested. The test results show that the model designed in this paper can effectively detect faces in various scenarios.

articleTitle: IQWOA: Improved Quantum Whale Optimization Algorithm for Clustering in Industrial Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As the core component of the Industrial Internet of Things, Industrial Wireless Sensor Network (IWSN) has played a significant role in promoting production automation. Different from conventional Wireless Sensor Network (WSN), IWSN has stricter requirements for data transmission delay and energy con-sumption. However, many existing IWSN clustering algorithms only focus on prolonging the lifetime of the network, rather than optimizing the delay of data transmission to the base station (BS). Therefore, an improved quantum whale optimization algorithm (IQWOA) specifically designed for clustering of IWSNs is pro-posed. Inspired by quantum computing, IQWOA has enhanced the solution quality of clustering scheme in IWSN by designing a novel quantum operator. The simulation results demonstrate that, compared with the existing IWSNs clustering algorithms, the proposed IQWOA effectively improves the network lifetime and reduces the transmission delay.

articleTitle: A Deep Neural Network for Fusion with Medical Image Pair
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Medical image fusion combines images collected from different medical devices to achieve complementarity between various medical images. In this article, we use the deep learning model to achieve the fusion of MRI and PET images. The model is mainly divided into feature extraction network and reconstruction network. In order to make the feature information extracted by each layer network can be effectively used without loss, we introduce dense block Improve the flow of information. Experiments show that our method can effectively achieve the fusion of MRI and PET images.

articleTitle: Sea-sky-line Detection Based on Improved YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Sea-sky-line detection plays an important role in the field of maritime object detection and unmanned boat. The traditional sea-sky-line detection method mainly starts from the direction of edge detection, and has poor applicability to the complex and changeable sea surface environment. In this paper, the deep-learning object detection method is introduced into the field of sea-sky-line detection. Through the lightweight improvement of YOLOv5 network and the replacement of its backbone network with MobileNet network, a sea-sky-line detection method based on the improved YOLOv5 algorithm is proposed and verified on the self-built dataset. The experimental results show that the proposed method can be applied to sea-sky-line detection in various scenarios. Compared with the traditional sea-sky-line detection algorithm, the proposed method has higher accuracy and stability, and has good portability and real-time performance compared with the original YOLOv5 network.

articleTitle: Research on Dark Web Monitoring Crawler Based on TOR
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The emergence of anonymity services provides the role of protecting user information security, it also provides a perfect venue for illegal and criminal activities such as human trafficking, illegal information transactions, and drugs and firearms. The anonymity, complexity of the structure, high-efficiency information distribution, and weak legal constraints of the dark web make it a new carrier for many criminals to carry out criminal activities. Therefore, in order to supervise criminals using the “dark web” to conduct illegal activities, a Python dark web monitoring crawler was designed based on Tor to obtain and store a large number of dark web site addresses; a web crawler based on the scrapy framework was established to crawl the dark web and specific types of crimes. Relevant website information is saved in the MongoDB database; data analysis is carried out by designing a crawler algorithm; finally, the analyzed data is generated through intuitive word cloud diagrams, histograms and other methods to generate a visual interface to facilitate real-time monitoring of dark web crimes.

articleTitle: Research on Joint Scheduling Method of Heterogeneous TT&C Network Resources Based on Improved DQN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the joint scheduling problem of heterogeneous TT&C network resources, a suitable model is established and solved by artificial intelligence algorithms. Construct a heterogeneous TT&C network resource scheduling model based on the characteristics of state-owned and commercial TT&C resources and the preference of TT&C resources, and use the improved DQN algorithm to solve the problem, and perform resource scheduling experiments under a certain scale scenario to obtain the optimal heterogeneous TT&C resource combination scheduling plan. The simulation results show that the designed improved DQN algorithm can effectively solve the joint scheduling optimization problem of heterogeneous TT&C resources.

articleTitle: An image encryption algorithm using two-dimensional chaotic map and DNA coding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: By improving the typical Sine map and Logistic map, a 2D chaotic map with good pseudo-randomness and a large chaotic range of parameters is derived. Based on the characteristics of DNA coding, an efficient image encryption algorithm is designed by combining chaotic map with DNA coding. Firstly, the image is divided into 8-bit planes by bit level operation, and the bit plane is divided into two modules by parity separation strategy. Then, the different DNA coding rules are used to encode the image, and then the DNA XOR is used to conduct the diffusion operation. After the diagonal diffusion on the image, the inverse diagonal diffusion is carried out. The image is divided into four blocks, and the diffusion operation is carried out within the four blocks. Simulation results and security analysis show that the proposed image encryption scheme has certain advantages compared with some existing methods.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting for Community Battery Systems based on Temporal Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Community battery systems are used for voltages control and peak load reduction in the decentralized grid. Daily forecast of electric loads is one of the critical steps in battery management of community battery systems. In most related works, the long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural networks RNN) has achieved the optimal performance but with poor parallelism and long training time requirement. In this study, temporal convolutional networks (TCN) based forecasting models with different structures are tested on real-world residential load data. Experiments show that all tried TCN models outperform LSTM in one-step forecasting with over 90% training time reduction. In multi-step forecasting, the TCN model with a large enough receptive can still outperform LSTM.

articleTitle: Research on The Requirements and Deployment of 5G MEC in Power Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The evolution of 5G technology and standards promotes its service bearing in power grid and other industries areas. As one of the important technologies in industrial 5G applications, multi-access edge computing (MEC) provides differentiated, distributed and customized functions for power grid, which gives high-performance network and computing ability to the industry. In order to promote the development of smart grid based on the integration of 5G and MEC, it is necessary to clarify the 5G MEC service requirements of the power grid and carry out research on its deployment strategy. This paper analyzed the demand of power service for 5G MEC integration. Combined with the power network architecture, this paper studied the deployment strategies of MEC on the base station side, regional side and convergence side of power wireless system, which is of great significance for the integrated development of 5G and power industry and improving power security level and service performance.

articleTitle: Clustering Multi-project based on Activities Sequence and Knowledge Investments Similarity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Many companies are faced with the need to improve their ability to manage multi-project to build competitiveness in a complex situation. Profiling (new product development) NPD projects, in order to compare them, find similar projects or sets via both project structural and attribute similarity, helps to manage multi-project efficiently. The combined similarity coefficient supports the multi-project management, hence, reduces overall time and cost and improves productivity. In this paper, we extend the part/product networked operations sequence similarity coefficient considering the influence of indirect activities sequence relationship and the weight of each activity flow to measure the project structural similarity. Then, we present knowledge investments-based project attribute similarity. Further, we use hierarchical clustering algorithm to group high similarity projects together. Finally, the multi-project case study is provided to validate the proposed model.

articleTitle: The Construction of Movie Recommendation System Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A movie recommendation system has been implemented based on python, B / S framework and MySQL database. Firstly, crawler technology is used to crawl the movie information of Douban, and then the crawled movie data is stored in MySQL. In the system, users can view, search and collect the movie information. According to the user's search history, the user-based collaborative filtering algorithm is used to recommend movies that may be of interest to users. Through the design of these functional modules, the whole movie recommendation system is realized.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy of Wind-Photovoltaic Hybrid Energy Storage Considering Prediction Error Compensation and Fluctuation Suppression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of wind power forecasting and suppress wind power fluctuations, a coordinated control strategy of wind-photovoltaic hybrid energy storage considering prediction error compensation and fluctuation suppression is proposed. Firstly, the target region of compensating prediction error and smoothing fluctuations is established by utilizing the statistical probability distribution to analyze the prediction error and power fluctuation. The charging / discharging reference power of the target domain for compensating prediction error is determined based on the upper and lower limits of the allowable prediction error while the charging/discharge reference power of the target domain for smoothing fluctuations is determined through first-order low-pass smooth filter curve. Then, power allocation is carried out based on spectrum analysis. The hybrid energy storage batteries are divided into four groups based on the target domain, so to realize the control of compensating prediction error and smoothing fluctuations in different working conditions. Finally, a wind farm is taken as an example to analyze the calculation example, and the result shows the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: The fake news propagate with more self-loop in online social networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, social networks such as Twitter and Weibo have developed rapidly. At the same time, false and harmful information has spread rapidly in online social networks like a plague and has caused a great negative impact on people who don't know the truth. We found that fake news turns to have different structural features of their propagation networks compared with that of real news. With careful analysis, we reveal that fake news is spread by the self-loop (one user reposts its own re-posting) to some degree. This abnormal spread pattern could be a feature of fake news identification and motivate future studies in this direction.

articleTitle: Research on construction technology of network security shooting range for power monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Under the background of the construction of “three types and two networks”, the introduction of a large number of heterogeneous intelligent terminals, ubiquitous open networks, interactive real-time control services and wide area interconnected power systems have transmitted the network security risks to all aspects of the power system. The security defense capability of power system is not only the superposition of security defense equipment, but also the excellent network security team. The continuous improvement of the level of network security is inseparable from the accumulation of network security attack and defense technology and practical experience, as well as practical tools and equipment with the characteristics of the power industry. In order to meet the increasingly severe security protection challenges, actively implement the security protection requirements of the power information system, ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system, build a network shooting range suited to the attributes of the power industry, and continuously improve the ability of network security protection, consolidate the foundation of digital transformation to ensure the safe and stable operation of power system and reliable power supply.The safe and stable operation of the information system needs to carry out comprehensive and in-depth vulnerability troubleshooting. In view of the lack of power business loophole mining and security event verification shooting range environment, this paper studies the power security shooting range construction technology.

articleTitle: Research on three loop control strategy based on flyback converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a flyback DC-DC converter is designed based on uc1825. The flyback circuit is controlled by peak current control. The converter is compensated for the right half plane zero point problem in the flyback circuit. In order to improve the response speed of the system, a voltage loop composed of PI controller is added on the basis of peak current control to form a three loop system, Matlab software and saber software are used for simulation verification, which effectively improves the response speed of the flyback circuit and ensures the stability of the system.Finally, the experimental results and simulation waveforms of the flyback circuit are given.

articleTitle: Artificial Reef Detection and Recognition Based on Faster-RCNN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of target detection of artificial reefs in the sea, the deep learning network Faster-RCNN and SSD are used to detect artificial reefs in the seabed images generated by multi-beam sonar grid data. Aiming at the problem of insufficient training samples, an AR21 data set was constructed. Based on this data set, the Faster-RCNN model and SSD model were trained using transfer learning, and verified on the test set. Experimental results show that the Faster-RCNN model has a detection accuracy of 95.53% and a recall rate of 98.83%. The SSD target detection model has an accuracy of 73.31% and a recall rate of 76.63%. The deep learning algorithm can identify artificial reefs more accurately and efficiently on multi-beam sonar images, and the Faster-RCNN model has higher accuracy, robustness and generalization capabilities.

articleTitle: Uncalibrated Visual Servo System Based on Kalman Filter Optimized by Improved STOA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The traditional visual servoing of robot is difficult to calibrate the parameters accurately. At present, Kalman filter is used to estimate the image Jacobian matrix, but the noise parameter setting is not appropriate, so the servoing is not accurate. The traditional STOA(Sooty Tern Optimization Algorithm) algorithm is improved by using the adaptive search radius strategy to improve its local convergence ability, and the improved STOA algorithm is used to optimize the noise parameters of Kalman filter, and the penalty term coefficient of the objective function is improved to find the optimal noise parameters under the current system model. Based on the optimal noise parameters obtained in this paper, the noise parameters are applied to the robot eye-in-hand structure, and the image Jacobian matrix is estimated online at each moment, so as to realize the calibration free visual servoing of the robot.

articleTitle: A Selenium-based Web Application Automation Test Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The quality of Web applications is a matter of great concern to current developers, testers and users. Some existing automated testing methods for Web applications have the problems as low efficiency, cannot be deal with dynamically loaded applications, cannot cope with frequent testing requirements, and so on. This paper designs and implements a Selenium-based Web application automation testing framework to solve the needs of automated testing of complex dynamic Web pages. In the experiment, the proposed framework is evaluated from multiple perspectives such as stability, test efficiency, and comparison with other frameworks. The results show that this framework has high test efficiency and can stably and quickly support automated testing of Web applications.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Detection Method of Catenary Equipment Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The transportation capacity of electrified railways can be more than double that of ordinary railways, and it has the advantages of low cost, low energy consumption and low environmental pollution. As one of the core and most important components of the electrified railway, the condition of the catenary will directly affect the safety and stable operation of railways. Therefore, the research of catenary fault detection and identification technology is very important. Aiming at the inefficiency of traditional methods, this paper proposes a deep learning-based catenary fault detection technology, introduces image processing technology into the electrified railway catenary detection system, and processes the photographs of railway equipment to realize the catenary equipment fault detection. Experiments prove that this method has good performance.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control of Wind Farm Power Prediction Based on PSO-MPC Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For wind farms, traditional control strategies cause a large amount of energy loss when dealing with wake effect, and traditional control strategies require all units to participate in, resulting in unnecessary unit actions. In this paper, a PSO-MPC control strategy is proposed. Based on the MPC (Model Predictive Control) model, the future outputs of wind farms are predicted according to the historical information and future inputs. Based on Jensen's wake model, a dynamic wind farm power model considering wake delay was established, and the output power of wind farm was connected with the axial flow factor controlling each unit. PSO (Particle swarm Optimization) algorithm was used to optimize the performance indexes in the prediction time domain by using predictive control information, and the control values of each fan were obtained. The simulation results show that compared with traditional wind farm control, the proposed control algorithm can effectively suppress the power fluctuation and improve the power tracking accuracy according to the prediction information, and control the speed of each unit in advance through the optimization results, reduce the unnecessary action of the unit, and thus reduce the unit loss.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Pumped Storage Power Plant Serving Power Grid Considering Energy Storage Ability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As a major regulating power source for power systems, pumped storage plays an important role in peak regulation, energy storage and promotion of new energy consumption, etc. It is important to comprehensively evaluate the service grid capacity of pumped storage power plant to better play its role. Based on this, this paper established an evaluation index system for pumped storage power plant with respect to the characteristics of peak regulation and energy storage and their contribution to achieve carbon peak and neutrality goals. A comprehensive evaluation method for pumped storage power plant serving the grid that considers the characteristics of energy storage is proposed, and finally validated by examples.

articleTitle: Power System Frequency Dynamic Simulation Analysis and Tool Development of PSS/E
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The continuous increase of the penetration of renewable energy sources makes system frequency dynamic behaviors change greatly under disturbance accidents. Obtaining system frequency response accurately is conductive to frequency dynamic behavior analysis and stability control strategies analysis. In this paper, PSS/E function extension is realized by using Python program to establish the auxiliary model and simulate boiler dynamic process and call the Application Program Interfaces (APIs). Adopting the given model structure and modifying the constant parameter makes PSS/E could consider the influences of frequency deviations on the output of boiler and auxiliaries. PSS/E function extension solves the disadvantage that PSS/E cannot handle the scenario with large frequency deviations in electromechanical transient simulation function. IEEE 39-buses system is used to illustrate the effects of boiler thermal state and the output of auxiliary on system frequency response characteristics and the validity of PSS/E extension modeling is verified by this typical example system.

articleTitle: Power supply scheme selection method of grid type underwater constant current remote supply network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The underwater remote power transmission system realizes the grid expansion of power supply range by means of constant current branch technology, but there are many different power supply combination schemes of main power supply loop and branch power supply loop. Different constant current transmission loops, including different underwater nodes and submarine cable sets, make the power supply combination schemes have different effects on the reliability performance of the underwater constant current remote supply network, it is necessary to study the method of evaluating the merits and demerits of the power supply scheme so as to maximize the reliability of the underwater cable network. Firstly, based on the working principle of constant current transmission, the diversity of power supply schemes is analyzed, and the connected graph abstract method of power supply schemes is proposed. Secondly, the reliability model of PBU, the key component of constant current branch power supply technology, is established, and related reliability analysis is carried out. Finally, the survival node rate is defined as the evaluation index of power supply scheme, and the selection method of power supply scheme is proposed from the Angle of network resistance to artificial attack and its own reliability respectively. By synthesizing the analysis conclusion of the two selection methods, the appropriate transmission scheme is selected for the grid constant current remote supply network.

articleTitle: Application of vision technology in metal surface defect detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The traditional metal surface defect detection needs to strengthen the surface features after soaking and air drying, and finally the defects are analyzed by manual visual inspection. Using machine vision technology, through the analysis of the image of the metal surface to be tested, the partial features of the defects are extracted, so as to realize the defect analysis of the metal surface. This paper compares Niblack algorithm and Sauvola algorithm of local threshold extraction, and introduces suppression factor on the basis of Sauvola algorithm, which improves the segmentation effect of Sauvola algorithm for areas with gentle gray change. At the same time, the integral image is used to optimize the algorithm, which further improves the time efficiency of the algorithm. After experimental comparison, the improved Sauvola algorithm can effectively detect scratches, stains and bumps on the metal surface.

articleTitle: Human-like Decision Making for Autonomous Lane Changing Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Machine learning technique has been shown to greatly improve the intelligence level of the decision-making system of intelligent vehicle. However, due to the complexity and uncertainty of the real-world traffic environment, its reliability is difficult to guarantee. To address this issue, a method for human-like autonomous lane changing decision-making that adopts hierarchical decision-making is proposed. We built a sample database by carrying out simulation driving experiments, based on the data-driven and deep learning LSTM method to generate lane changing intention, and further verify the rationality of the intention through constraint rules. The simulation experimental results show that this method can safely and effectively realize the autonomous lane changing of intelligent vehicle, which can provide a reference for the research of intelligent vehicle decision-making technology.

articleTitle: Using Landsat-8 imagery and Generative Adversarial Network for Glacial Lakes Mapping in High Mountain Regions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As an essential resource in High Mountain Regions (HMR), evaluating the glacial lake dynamics is of great significance to explore the impacts of climate changes and predict the risks of Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs). However, complicated and laborious methods for glacial lake mapping are unpractically applied in automatically monitoring glacial lakes at a large-scale region. In this work, we explored the mapping efficiency of glacial lakes by combing Generative Adversarial Networks and multi-level feature pyramid (GANMFP) in HMR. We first sampled the image patches containing glacial lakes from Landsat-8 raw data to evaluate the model performance. Totally, 6583 patches with 256x256x7 pixels are randomly cropped from 62 Landsat-8 images. Then we employed these data to train and test the GAN model, which integrated a multi-level feature fusion module in generator and a Resnet-152 networks in discriminator. From the validation results and result visualization, our method achieved good performances in Precision (88.42), Recall (59.61), and Overall Accuracy (99.28), which shows excellent potential in glacial lake mapping at a large-scale region.

articleTitle: Co-simulation study of automobile two-degree-of-freedom steering model and VTD scenario model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of autonomous driving technology, simulation evaluation technology has been more applications in the industry. Among them, the integration accuracy of the simulation model is the key to ensuring the effectiveness of the evaluation, and joint verification studies are needed. This paper systematically analyzes the cornering force of the front and rear tires of the vehicle during steering, solves the differential equation of the vehicle's motion, establishes a two-degree-of-freedom model, and builds a simulation model based on Matlab/Simulink; then through the steering demonstration case and the Carsim model Make a comparison to verify the effectiveness of the two-degree-of-freedom steering model. Finally, a two-degree-of-freedom steering model was used to replace the original vehicle model of the VTD software, and a joint model was constructed. The error between the preset path of the VTD scene and the response path of the two-degree-of-freedom steering model under the same torque was compared and analyzed, which confirmed The effectiveness and stability of the joint model.

articleTitle: A 3D Reconstruction Method for Augmented Reality Sandbox Based on Depth Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper builds an Augmented Reality Sandbox (AR Sandbox) system based on augmented reality technology, and performs a 3D reconstruction for the sandbox terrain using the depth sensor Microsoft Kinect in the AR Sandbox, as an entry point to pave the way for later development of related metaverse applications, such as the metaverse architecting and visual interactive modeling. The innovation of this paper is that for the AR Sandbox scene, a 3D reconstruction method based on depth sensor is proposed, which can automatically cut off the edge of the sandbox table in Kinect field of view, and accurately and completely reconstruct the sandbox terrain in Matlab.

articleTitle: An ESD layout reliability verification method based on PERC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the increasing scale of integrated circuits and the smaller process size, ESD (Electro-Static discharge) reliability verification has become an essential task in the design of SoC chips. The ESD protection circuits provide ESD current paths to avoid damage caused by electrostatic current flowing into the internal circuits of IC during ESD discharge. This paper introduces the causes, types and protection requirements of electrostatic discharge, focusing on the impact of parasitic resistance on ESD in layout and the automatic extraction of ESD parasitic resistance based on PERC tool. The verification method described in the paper can be used in inspection of the reliability of ESD layout in SOC chip.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, computer vision technology that simulates human vision has received widespread attention. Based on the current commonly used method of computer vision technology-deep learning, this paper outlines the development of deep learning models, and determines the inflection point of the development of the introduction of convolutional neural networks. Not only that, convolutional neural networks combined with deep learning have developed rapidly and are widely used in the field of computer vision. Therefore, the structure and development process of the convolutional neural network are further analyzed. Subsequently, the three major difficulties in the field of computer vision-image classification, object detection, and image segmentation are compared and analyzed, and their differences and connection analysis are drawn. Finally, an overview of the difficulties to be optimized in computer vision, and computer vision technology It will continue to develop as a research hotspot.

articleTitle: Service Priority Based WiFi6 Optimized Handover Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of the electric power Internet of Things (IoT), the demand for service transmission of IoT terminals is gradually increasing. The emergence of WiFi6 can support low-cost, high-efficiency and high-speed wireless power communication network. The multi-service transmission in the electric power IoT is expected to be optimized. Therefore, this article analyzes the resource division method with orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) technology used in WiFi6. Next, a handover scheduling model based on service priority which considers the influence of received signal strength and transmission cost is proposed. Finally, we design a handover decision algorithm based on genetic algorithm. Simulation experiments show that the algorithm in this paper can realize AP optimized handover according to different service priorities and optimize the transmission quality of power communication networks.

articleTitle: Research on charge-discharge equalization strategy of aviation battery based on Gaussian variation function
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: According to the direct-to-direct conversion characteristics of the Cuk circuit, the bidirectional Cuk circuit equalization circuit is used, and the Gaussian variogram algorithm is used to control the battery charging and discharging, and to balance the inconsistency of the single battery power during the charging and discharging process of the aviation battery. By building a 4-cell lithium battery series simulation model, constructing a Gaussian algorithm model, and performing simulation verification, it is obtained that the equilibrium control strategy can complete the single battery to the entire battery, the entire battery to the single battery, and the multi-cell to the multi-cell SOC Inconsistent balance. Therefore, the circuit is simple and the practical value is high.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life of Lithium-ion batteries based on EMD-GSA-ELM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The widespread popularity of new energy vehicles has a higher demand for accurately determining battery health and ensuring battery safety performance. Considering that the capacity regeneration phenomenon during using lithium batteries is difficult to track, the model is difficult to build, and the prediction accuracy is not high. In order to reduce the computational complexity and improve the efficiency of establishing a lithium-ion battery remaining life prediction model, a method of fusion of empirical mode decomposition and extreme learning machine based on gravity search algorithm is proposed to establish a lithium battery remaining life prediction model. First, introduce EMD to analyze the battery's early health factor and capacity data to obtain fluctuation and trend components. Second, obtain a battery capacity decay prediction model by learning and training on different components. Finally, use NASA's lithium-ion battery test data to verify the performance of the EMD-GSA-ELM model. The experimental results show that the proposed model can better track the capacity decline and has better accuracy.

articleTitle: Research On Information Fusion Technique of Infrared-Laser Compound Seeker
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For the infrared-laser composite seeker, the seeker fusion algorithm is studied in the simultaneous working period of the dual-mode detector. For the purpose of obtaining the control parameters under simultaneous control, make full use of the advantages of different detection performance, according to the difference of different single-mode sensors in the target recognition and tracking process under the same environment, give full play to the advantages of the same control mode information fusion algorithm, and study the information fusion process and algorithm of the multi-mode compound guidance system based simultaneous control, laying the foundation for subsequent engineering applications.

articleTitle: Study on Modeling Method of Chemical Composition of Tobacco for Micro Near Infrared Instrument
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The quality analysis of the chemical composition in the process of tobacco purchasing and baking has become focus of the enterprises attention. At present, the chemical composition analysis in conventional laboratories is time-consuming and laborious, which cannot meet the practical application requirements. There is an urgent need for the instrument with low development cost and miniaturization for tobacco quality analysis. Therefore, based on DLP near infrared analysis module DLPNIRNANOEVM of TI company, this paper studies the modeling method of tobacco chemical composition. The spectral data of samples collected by micro near infrared instrument has the characteristics of low resolution, high noise and weak signal. Therefore, the basic PLS modeling method and spectral preprocessing method are optimized in this paper, and the mathematical models of total sugar, reducing sugar, total nitrogen and nicotine in tobacco are established according to the relationship between content values and the spectra. The experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the accuracy and robustness of the model, which provides an important reference for the practical application of micro near infrared spectrometer.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Import of Driving Scenario Based on VTD
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of the automatic driving technology of the intelligent connected vehicle, the driving scenario, as a key element for the development and verification of the auto-driving technology functions, has received more and more attention. Based on the acquired dynamic scenario data, a method to automatically generate Open Scenario format files from dynamic scenario data is studied in this paper. The workload of manual writing is reduced, and the efficiency is improved. Finally, the automatically generated scenarios are verified by Virtual Test Drive (VTD).

articleTitle: Slam and Navigation of Electric Power Intelligent Inspection Robot based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high development cost and poor maintenance of electric inspection robot, a control system scheme of inspection robot based on the robot operating system (ROS) was proposed. Based on the concept of hierarchical control, the control system of the inspection robot is divided into user layer, decision layer and executive layer, each layer has a clear function, low coupling and strong expansibility. The user layer is mainly used to receive the user's application instructions and play the role of human-computer interaction. The decision layer mainly undertakes the core budget of robot positioning and navigation, path planning, etc., which is realized by an industrial control computer and ROS. The executive layer based on STM32 mainly functions as the motion controller of the robot and executes the control instructions sent by the decision layer to control the robot movement. The test results show that the control system has the advantages of accurate drawing and positioning, low cost, and can meet the engineering requirements.

articleTitle: Small Object Detection with Improved CenterNet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Detection of small objects is a notorious challenge due to their properties of low resolution and less information. Most existing works aim for general object detection while ignoring the impact of the object size, resulting in high missed detection rate of small objects, making it difficult to apply object detection in real scenarios such as autonomous driving. The implementation of an efficient detection algorithm for small objects is thus worth discussing. In this paper, we propose a small object detection framework with improved CenterNet. Specifically, the proposed framework consists of four parts. The super-resolution (SR) subnetwork enhances the information contained in small objects by generating an SR version of the original image. The future pyramid subnetwork fuses different levels of features thereby retaining semantic information of small objects. The center localization header and the size regression header are combined to detect objects via prediction of object center and object size. In this way, the performance of object detection is improved especially on small objects. We have conducted comprehensive experiments on MS COCO benchmark, and the experimental results have proved the effectiveness of our framework, especially in the detection of small objects better than existing methods.

articleTitle: Signal Classification in Real-time Based on SDR using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the modern complex battlefield environment, traditional conventional parameter measurement, fixed template matching and other methods are difficult to accurately identify unknown target signals and determine threats, and could not implement effective electronic attack. To solve the above problems, this paper designs a software radio system based on (Software-Defined Radio)SDR deep learning real-time signal classification. The system adopts the optimized convolutional neural network and uses training samples with different SNR(Signal-Noise Ratio) to enhance the robustness of the recognition network in various SNR environments. Finally, over the air test is realized by Pluto SDR platform, the accuracy of signal classification can reach at 96.83%. The system can complete the classification and recognition of typical radio signal modulation patterns in the battlefield. It has the advantages of high recognition accuracy and flexible deployment. It provides a new method and means to solve the difficulties of communication target reconnaissance and jamming.

articleTitle: Research on self-balancing unmanned bicycle based on cascade PID control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Bicycle is a kind of underactuated and unstable zero dynamic system. In order to realize the balance control and automatic tracking of unmanned bicycle, Lagrange method is used to model the bicycle system and analyze its dynamic model. At the same time, combined with the skills and experience of driving bicycle, a cascade PID control method is proposed. This method can couple the balance control and line inspection control, avoid the conflict between balance and steering, and improve the system response speed and control accuracy. The steering data of the electromagnetic sensor is taken as the output variable of the outer loop control, and then the inclination angle and angular velocity of the bicycle are fused by the Kalman filter algorithm to obtain stable and accurate body attitude angle data, which is used as the inner loop feedback of PID control and cascade control with the output of the outer loop. The effectiveness and practicability of the cascade PID control method are verified by the self-made experimental prototype. The experimental data of the prototype show that the wheel deflection angle converges quickly and returns to the balance position after a short oscillation under the condition of active disturbance balance, which shows strong robustness. The scheme can provide reference for the engineering implementation of the bicycle without tracking.

articleTitle: Cloud-based Computation Offloading In Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper studies computation offloading in cloudbased vehicular networks. Cloud-based vehicular networks are a promising paradigm to improve vehicular services through vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication mode, when mobile users in vehicles that are not equipped with powerful computing devices, they can offload time-sensitive and computationintensive tasks to remote cloud center or edge servers. However, high mobility of the vehicles may cause degradation of the offloading efficiency and unstable communication links between vehicles and edge servers. To solve this problem and reduce the transmission cost of the computation offloading, we propose a cloud-based offloading scheme in vehicular networks, which consider the mobility of the vehicles and the cooperation of the edge servers, the objective is to effectively utilize the computation resources of the edge servers, in this scheme, vehicles can offload tasks to servers out of its own communication range through predictive relay transmissions. Due to high mobility of vehicles, a dynamic programming-based predictive search algorithm (DPA) is proposed to find a set of the edge servers to offload the tasks, and this algorithm minimize the total energy consumption while ensuring that communication link is alive during the computation offloading process. Illustrative results are shown the performance of our proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Small Object Detection Algorithm for Power Embedded Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Currently in the power industry, there has been a demand for intelligent computing and real-time feedback at the edge using embedded devices. However, in some scenarios, the excessive computation still seriously affects the practicality of intelligent edge devices. Take transmission inspection drone aerial images as an example, the requirement to identify some small objects at large resolution makes the inference model can only be deployed on servers or desktops with strong computing power support. In order to realize the practicality of edge intelligence devices for small object detection, this paper adopts the strategy of hierarchical object detection. This paper first analyzes the problems faced by small object detection under constrained computation and proposes the strategy of using hierarchical object detection, then refines the design and validation of the sliding window selection for hierarchical object detection, and finally selects the base model to be used considering the accuracy, inference speed, and other factors. This enables fast detection of small objects such as missing pins on resource-limited embedded devices with good detection results.

articleTitle: Construction of Knowledge Map in Coal Mine Gas Drainage Field based on Word Attention
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of multiple sources, difficult integration and low availability of knowledge in the field of coal mine gas drainage, a method for constructing the knowledge map in the field of coal mine gas drainage is proposed. The automatic acquisition of knowledge in the field of gas drainage is realized by establishing the domain knowledge base, entity recognition is realized based on word attention combination Bi-LSTM-CRF, and the relationship between entities is extracted by constructing gradient boosting decision tree, The entity conflict is eliminated from the perspective of semantic similarity, and the neo4j graphic database is used to store and visualize the knowledge in the field of gas drainage.

articleTitle: Research on Authentication and Key Negotiation Based on Smart Water Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: More and more countries are exploring smart city related smart facilities to benefit the society. Remote access and control of IOT smart devices is convenient, but there are also some risks. Smart devices may be attacked by criminals who will do serious harm to the production environment. It is particularly important to design a safe and efficient secure communication scheme. Most existing solutions to this problem are usually based on single server architecture, which has some problems in security and efficiency. Aiming at the problem that authentication and key agreement in smart water conservancy are vulnerable to SPOF and DDOS attacks, this paper proposes an authentication key agreement technology based on blockchain. In key agreement, the identity of smart devices can not be tampered with, which can effectively resist man in the middle attack. In the process of protocol execution, the nodes of smart devices are light nodes. The process of key agreement is carried out in the smart contract, which reduces the computational complexity and improves the operation efficiency. This paper also analyzes the security of the scheme.

articleTitle: An improved k-means algorithm based on density normalization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the the accuracy of k-means algorithm, many improved k-means algorithms by selecting the initial center point have been proposed. However, even if the initial centers is selected, the size, shape and density of the clusters in the dataset will still affect the clustering performance. An improved k-means algorithm based on density normalization method (DNK-means) is proposed which uses data transformation to solve above problem. The main idea of the algorithm is to calculate the nearest neighbor density of each point and find the point with the highest density among its nearest neighbors. The point with the highest nearest neighbor density is regarded as a candidate point. These candidate points are constructed into a minimum spanning tree to obtain initial centers. The normalized dataset is obtained by transform all points of dataset to their nearest neighbor with highest density. Finally, k-means is employed on the processed dataset to obtain the final clustering result. DNK-means algorithm is tested on some well-known datasets from UCI machine learning repository. The results show that our algorithm achieves better clustering results than the traditional k-means algorithm and latest improved k-means algorithm.

articleTitle: Recognition of Overlapped Objects via Weakly-Supervised Methods with Bag of Alphabets
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Weakly supervised learning can adjust model parameters by exploring image-level annotations, thus significantly reducing the cost of labeling samples. Although many efforts have been made to reduce the performance gap compared to supervised learning with expensive annotations, this article focuses on overlapped objects' adverse effects in recognizing overlapped objects via weakly supervised methods. In order to identify overlapped objects by weak supervision method, the current Bag-of-Words (BOW) framework for non-overlapped objects is modified to Bag-of-Alphabets (BOA), the words of objects corresponding to the alphabets of its parts. As a result, the un-covered factors of objects can significantly contribute to object recognition even when others may cover them.
