So, compared to BOW, a novel method, BOA is created to combine alphabets of parts into words of objects.

articleTitle: An image segmentation method of lung lymphatic tumors based on PET-CT images
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To address the problem from lymphatic tumor segmentation from PET-CT images, this paper presents an image segmentation method based on pulse-coupled neural network (PCNN). PET-CT image detection can provide more detailed tumor information for later diagnosis and treatment, while our adjustable fire-controlled MSPCNN model (AFC-MSPCNN) can segment lung tumors effectively. Related experiment results show that our proposed method can improve the image segmentation accuracy than other competitive methods.

articleTitle: Using Holt-Winters and IF-XGBoost model to detect the abnormal condition of PV system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) power generation is one of the primary forms of electricity generation. This paper proposes the Holt-Winters(HW) and IF-XGBoost model based on Bayesian optimization to identify the abnormal condition of PV systems. HW is used to predict the expected output power, and multidimensional features are constructed using the predicted power and time series. The study construct the IF-XGBoost model with isolation forest(IF) and XGBoost, adopting the Bayesian optimization to optimize the hyperparameters in HW and IF-XGBoost. The proposed methods are validated by comparing the accuracy of different models. The result shows that the IF-XGBoost model is better than other models, whose F1-score is 0.981 on the test set. Furthermore, IF-XGBoost demonstrates better performance on the test set with the white Gaussian noise. This paper provides a scheme for early abnormal condition detection and early warning in large-scale PV systems.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Mimic Defense in Industrial Control System Security
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The attacks and defenses in industrial control system(ICS) security has been in an asymmetrical situation. Due to the closeness, specificity and complexity of ICS, it has more vulnerabilities and deeper hidden backdoors. The traditional “remedy” type of defense is difficult to prevent increasingly complex attack methods. Starting from the attack chain model, this paper analyzes shortcomings of traditional ICS defense technology, and proposes an ICS security system structure based on mimic defense. Digital twin technology is used to build executive entities of mimic defense model, and increase the dynamic and heterogeneity of ICS. The system structure based on mimic defense has better protection against unknown vulnerabilities, and reduces the probability of being attacked successfully, improve the ICS's ability to withstand attacks through endogenous security at the system level, and alleviate the passive and lagged situation of ICS defense.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-based Airplane Meteorological Data Sharing Incentive System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The airplane can collect meteorological data during climb, cruise, and descent phases of the airplane through airborne sensors. The meteorological data detected by the airplane can make up for the shortfall of the atmosphere data detected over the ocean and in the upper atmosphere by existing meteorological data detection means. However, airline companies may not actually take the initiative to share the meteorological data detected by airplanes for reasons of information security and privacy protection, resulting in a waste of data assets. In order to encourage airline companies to share the meteorological data detected by airplanes, this paper proposes an important meteorological data sharing incentive system based on the blockchain. The system can realize the sharing of meteorological data detected by airplanes among the airline companies under the premise of privacy protection, and under the action of the incentive mechanism, increases the willingness of airline companies to share important weather information. The airplane meteorological data sharing incentive system proposed in this paper can strengthen the airline companies' ability to monitor, forecast and warn important weather, and thus improve the flight safety.

articleTitle: EEG Effective Channel Selection based on Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the target detection task of brain-computer interface based on the fast sequence visual presentation (RSVP), P300 is usually used as the most effective feature to capture the target image in the rapidly presented image stream. For online rsvp experiments, the target detection speed is one of the important parameters in the application. For EEG data from whole brain channels, too many channels will bring too much redundant information, which will bring more time complexity and invalid features to the data processing. In the p300-based target detection experiment, people usually simply select the channel data of the central area of the p300 fixed brain area for target detection in the experiment, but there is no detailed analysis of the selection of different brain areas and the quantitative comparison of results. This paper selects the frontal and parietal areas, and does an interpretation experiment of infrared ship images. The experimental results of different brain areas are compared and analyzed offline. Compared with other electrode selection schemes, the EEG signals of 53 electrodes related to frontal region, parietal region and central region reached the highest classification accuracy, the accuracy is 89.38%. In addition, the test results may provide some ideas for the reduction of channels in wearable devices.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Fault Diagnosis of Satellite Power Shunt
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The cost of satellite system is expensive. Once the power system components fail, it may cause serious consequences to the whole satellite system. It is an effective means to improve the safety and reliability of satellite to carry out fault diagnosis research. In the paper, based on the in-depth study of the composition, structure and working principle of satellite power system, the satellite power system model is built, and then the failure mode and effects of satellite power shunts are analyzed. Finally, according to the characteristics of the shunt, a knowledge-based fault diagnosis method is used to formulate the strategy of the shunt fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Gesture Recognition Based on Improved Template Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low recognition rate when recognizing the left and right hands with traditional gesture features, a feature <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H$</tex> (Hand-to-hand angle) based on the angle between the hands is designed to describe the positional relationship of the left and right hands. At the same time, a new gesture recognition algorithm is proposed to solve the interference problem of undefined gestures in the recognition process. Based on the template matching method, similarity judgment is introduced to filter out interfering gestures. Finally, real-time classification and recognition of static gestures are realized. Experiments show that this gesture recognition algorithm can effectively filter out interfering gestures, and the recognition rate of static gestures is up to 96%.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis between transaction price and wind power generation based on copula function
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Under the national goal of “peak carbon dioxide emissions, carbon neutrality”, new energy power generation will be vigorously developed. Real-time trading in power spot market can give full play to market regulation and promote the consumption of renewable energy. However, the power generation of new energy sources, such as wind and light, is uncertain. When it is connected in a large proportion, it will cause fluctuations in the voltage, current and frequency of the power grid, cause misoperation, tripping, refusing to operate and damage of automatic devices, affect the power quality of the power grid, and have a certain impact on the power market. Therefore, this paper analyzes the direct correlation between wind power generation and clearing price based on Copula function. Firstly, the definition and classification of Copula function are introduced, and suitable symmetrical Archimedean function is selected from many types of Copula function. Secondly, correlation index method and variable correlation index are selected to analyze the relationship between Copula function parameters and a variable correlation index. Finally, facing the power transaction of high proportion of new energy, the wind power generation and transaction price in Denmark are analyzed, and it is concluded that there is a strong correlation between clearing price and wind power generation in Denmark.

articleTitle: Tool geometries optimization based on machine learning for aviation parts towards green manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Tool geometries optimization is of great importance to reduce cutting energy consumption and tool wear of aeronautical parts under green manufacturing background. Considering this, a machine learning prediction and optimization method is proposed. Firstly, a prediction method, e.g. a tuned Random Forest Regression (RFR) is built up to model the relationship between tool geometries and cutting energy consumption as well as tool wear. Secondly, based on the prediction model, an optimization function of tool geometries is formulated, and seven-spot ladybird algorithm (SLO) is adopted to solve the function. Then, the turning process of aviation shaft parts, which is made of Aluminum alloy (AA) 7075 is viewed as the research object, and Finite Element Method (FEM) is introduced to undertake the simulation machining and generate training and testing data for prediction and optimization. Results show that, compared with previous geometries, the optimized tool geometries could reduce 30.47% and 29.95% of cutting energy consumption and tool wear, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method to explore energy saving potentials in aviation parts manufacturing.

articleTitle: Design of college student information sharing system based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: College Students information sharing is of great significance for college students' employment and enterprise recruitment, and it can improve the recruitment efficiency. As blockchain technology has been gradually applied to the sharing system in many fields, this paper presents the design of college student information system based on blockchain, which mainly including system architecture and main process design, as well as key technologies such as consensus algorithm and smart contract deployment. The system has good security and traceability, and provides a new idea for college students' information sharing.

articleTitle: Research on the Detection Method of Road Rain, Snow and Icing Based on Image
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the high cost and low timeliness of the current road monitoring methods due to rain, snow and icing, this paper proposes an image-based fusion detection method. Through deep learning ResNet50 residual network, a preliminary model for automatic recognition and classification of the images of road weather is obtained, and its average recognition accuracy can reach more than 85%; the icing thickness detection method proposed in this paper can also be measured more accurately. The error range of the icing thickness of the road surface can be controlled within the range of 0.5mm-1mm,

articleTitle: Discussion on influence of moisture absorption on the reliability of integrated circuit package
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper started with the main factors affecting the reliability of IC product, introduce the concept of moisture absorption and analyze the influence mechanism of water vapor into the plastic package body, the corrosion mechanism of water vapor to chip PAD aluminum layer is analyzed in detail, how water vapor causes structural stratification and resin crack between the various parts of the plastic package, and the mechanism of the damage caused by water vapor to wire, in order to solve the water vapor on the plastic package products brought about by the quality of hidden dangers, this paper puts forward to the improvement direction of controlling and reducing moisture absorption from the aspects of package design, process, material and environment, and gives suggestions for improvement.

articleTitle: Design and Experiment of Smart Fire Electric Power Monitoring System Based on the Cyber-Physical Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to realize smart fire electric power alarm monitoring, this paper designs a smart fire electric power monitoring system based on the cyber-physical model. In the physical space, the system receives the information, including the voltage, temperature, current, instantaneous power and other characteristic data from the SDF400 fault electric arc detection sensor. In the information space, the system builds a feature anomaly judgment model based on the kmeans++ clustering algorithm and the mathematical criterion including bessel formula and raida criterion. Experimental test data show that the anomaly judgment model has an average 92.4% correct alarm rate and 2% false alarm rate. The precise results of the model provide a basis for smart fire electric power safety monitoring and support smart power control application scenarios such as smart circuit closing.

articleTitle: Research on Grid-based Abnormal Behavior Identification Method of Ships
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To realize the identification of abnormal behaviors of ships, a grid-based method for identifying abnormal behaviors of ships based on the speed, course, and position data collected in a fixed time window is proposed. The density-based clustering algorithm is used to cluster the historical ship position data, realize the classification of the channel type and construct its grid parameter model. For the speed and course data after the mean value normalization and Box-Cox transformation, the parameter estimation method is used to identify the abnormal speed and heading. The ray method and density-based outlier detection algorithm are used to realize the identification of ships entering and exiting the detection waters and abnormal locations respectively. Taking the ship data downstream of Gezhouba as an example, the above method was tested and verified. The results show that the grid parameter model is suitable for the detection and identification of abnormal behavior of inland watercraft. Based on this model, the abnormal state of the ship's speed, course and position can be effectively identified, and the abnormal behavior of the ship can be accurately judged. The research results can provide technical support for inland watercraft navigation risk analysis, and forecasting and early warning.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Landscape Image Style Transfer based on Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The traditional style transfer technique in landscape image has the problem of semantic mismatching in different scenes. In this paper, based on the convolution and landscape style transfer algorithm of neural network, and analyses the semantic segmentation algorithm in theory, based on the normalized statistics of image style transfer algorithm (BN-NST) algorithm was designed on the basis of landscape style transfer algorithm based on semantic segmentation (BS-NST), solve the problem of semantic matching accuracy in different scenarios. In order to verify the algorithm, this paper uses the improved Deeplabv3+ network model and the convolutional neural network algorithm to process the input content image and style image, and the obtained target image has the advantages of authenticity and appreciation of landscape photos.

articleTitle: High Performance Shipborne Message Queuing Service Prototype System Based on Apache Pulsar
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development and application of shipborne information technology, the integration of shipboard information system (SIS) becomes more and more complex, and the communication between shipborne information platforms needs the guarantee of lightweight, high reliability, low latency, high performance and expansibility. In this paper, according to the characteristics of integration and communication in SIS, as well as the requirements of information transmission, such as marine target detection, multi-source heterogeneous marine data fusion, critical control and detection, a high-performance shipborne message queue service prototype system is designed and constructed based on Apache Pulsar. The prototype system implements message feedback mechanism and message priority queue strategy based on point-to-point and publish-subscribe patterns, which effectively reduces the complexity of shipborne application communication. In addition, the prototype system not only ensures the reliability of message transmission, but also greatly ensures the real-time performance and throughput of message transmission. The experimental results show that the prototype system proposed in this paper can effectively ensure the reliability of data communication between shipborne information platforms, and meet the requirements of low latency and high performance of SIS.

articleTitle: Research on Recommendation Algorithm Based on E-commerce User Behavior Sequence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid rise and development of the Internet, e-commerce has become one of the most promising and fastest-growing industries. we propose an architecture of a personalized recommendation system based on offline mining, real-time mining, and deep learning technology. First, through the Flume + Kafka + Spark Streaming system, user behavior data is collected and stored in the business database after data preprocessing First, through the Flume + Kafka + Spark Streaming system, user behavior data is collected and stored in the business database after data preprocessing, which is the work preparing for the next step of data mining. Data mining includes offline mining and real-time mining. Offline mining mainly runs MapReduce on the Hadoop platform, there are also some calculations on the Spark platform, and the calculation results are stored in the business database; The implementation of real-time mining mainly is based on the message subscription of the Kafka cluster, and get real-time consumption statistics through Spark clusters; Deeplearning4j, a deep learning framework, runs on a multi-GPU Spark distributed cluster, which can be optimized the algorithm model online and generate recommendation results to push to the real-time business database and give feedback to the users.; It can also extract features from these data for training automatically, which is conducive to improving the quality and efficiency of users' shopping decisions, and improve the platform's cross-selling capabilities, shorten the user's shopping path, increase traffic conversion rates.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Context Network for Image Inpainting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Although the existing image inpainting methods can generate seemingly reasonable contents. However, these methods may produce image artifacts. This is because the image details are lost in the coding process, and the relationship between distant pixels cannot be modeled. To solve these problems, we propose a multi-scale context network (MSCN), which attempts to extract different levels of feature information and fuse them to reconstruct a complete image. MSCN uses encoder-decoder structure and consists of cascaded residual blocks. Then, we designed a multi-scale dilated convolution (MSDC) module to obtain richer contextual features by increasing the receptive field. Finally, the encoder features are fused into the decoder by the improved attention (IA) module. A large number of experiments on CelebA-HQ, FFHQ, and PairStreet datasets show that this method can effectively generate realistic and visually credible results.

articleTitle: Analysis of Visual Effects Configuration Scheme for Small Cultural Complex
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Stage lighting design is an important step in the visual effect configuration scheme of small cultural complex. This paper mainly discusses the lighting configuration of small space with multi-functional art services under different modes such as performance, conference, exhibition, reading and folk customs. Focusing on the analysis of lighting layout methods in drama and artistic performances, this paper takes the drama performing environment as the representative. Through the corresponding subjective evaluation experiments, research and data analysis are carried out on the lamps and lighting methods adopted in the performance. Furthermore, the optimal configuration effect of front light and top light under given constraints is selected. The research provides an effective reference for the lighting configuration of small cultural complexes, which has certain application value and practical significance.

articleTitle: Denitrification based on new prediction algorithm Application Research of control system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present,the selective catalytic reduction (SCR) method is usually used to remove nitrogen oxides from flue gas in thermal power units.This method is affected by the characteristics of chemical reaction,flue flow field and analytical instruments,which makes it difficult for denitration control to reach the control quality index,The improved dynamic matrix control algorithm is used to replace the conventional PID closed-loop control strategy on site to make up for the lack of timeliness and poor robustness of PID algorithm for the control of objects with strong delay and large delay.At the same time the BP neural network feed-forward strategy is adopted to predict the change trend of nitrogen oxides according to the combustion situation of furnace and to inject ammonia ahead of time to prevent the outlet from exceeding the standard,The control effect of precise ammonia injection is realized.

articleTitle: Fault Simulation Analysis of Distribution Network Considering Unbalanced Power Grid Effects
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the grounding line selection effect of the small current system is not satisfactory because of the three-phase unbalance. The causes of three-phase unbalance are analyzed. In addition, the causes of unbalanced current caused by unbalanced capacitance, unbalanced load and asymmetric parameters of current transformer are studied. It is verified that the three-phase unbalance will lead to the failure of route selection theoretically. In order to extract the characteristic signal of single-phase fault in unbalanced power grid, a simulation model of single-phase grounding fault in three-phase unbalanced resonant grounding system is built by using MATLAB / Simulink software. Through some of simulation experiments on unbalanced distribution network single-phase fault, the effect of existing line selection methods under three-phase unbalanced condition is analyzed, which provides a theoretical basis for the study of single-phase fault line selection method under unbalanced condition.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Three-phase VSR Based on A Feed-forward Control strategy in Stationary Coordinate System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To improve the anti-interference ability of three phase voltage source PWM rectifier and overcome the shortcomings of complex control structure and difficult tuning of control parameters in dq coordinate system, a feed-forward control strategy based on αβ coordinate system is proposed: because of the application of predictive current principle and the design of control system in static coordinate system, the difficulty of design is reduced, and by adopting anti-interference feed forward control technology, the problem that three-phase VSR is greatly affected by input voltage fluctuation and output current variation of power grid has been solved. The system simulation model is built, and the effectiveness of the control strategy is verified.

Author Keywords: three phase voltage source PWM rectifier

articleTitle: Parameter identification of second order equivalent circuit of thyristor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The internal damping resistance and damping capacitance of the thyristor have nameplate values when it is just released from the factory, and after using it for a period of time, the parameters of the internal damping resistance and damping capacitance of the thyristor have changed, resulting in deviating from the real value and not being the parameters on the nameplate. To address this problem, this paper designs a parameter identification method for the second-order equivalent circuit of the thyristor based on adaptive control, and the internal damping resistance and damping capacitance of the thyristor. The parameter identification is carried out. In this paper, a Tracking Differentiator (TD) is proposed to extract the input signal with perturbation and filter the input signal to achieve an accurate estimation of the thyristor device parameters. In the identification of parameters, the gradient descent method in adaptive control is chosen in this paper to identify the parameters of the thyristor circuit. Finally, the input signal and the estimated parameters are simulated using MATLAB. The simulation results show that the Active Disturbance Rejection Control (ADRC) strategy applied in this paper can better suppress the disturbances and the adaptive control strategy is faster and more accurate in identifying the parameters inside the thyristor second-order circuit.

articleTitle: Research on a Removable Charging System Considering Mixed Step Utilization of Super Capacitance and Power Battery
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The contradiction between the large-scale promotion of electric vehicles and the lagging construction of charging stake is increasingly prominent. Emergency charging technology for electric vehicles needs to be proposed urgently. In addition, power batteries will soon usher in the first retirement peak in the country. How to effectively and environmentally handle the above issues has become a hot research topic.This paper puts forward the mixed step utilization of power batteries and super capacitors after retirement, and designs a removable energy storage and charging system. For the problems of low current and slow charging in the step utilization of existing power batteries, the mixed power supply mode of decommissioned power batteries and super capacitors is proposed to improve the charging efficiency.Engineering practice has proved that the design shown in this paper has higher charging rate and greater practicability than that of a single power battery mobile charging system.

articleTitle: Research on Virtualization Technology of Power Information Network Security Access
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the current power information network border security access devices cannot meet the convenient access of massive power IoT terminals, this paper analyzes the traditional security access methods, such as uneven resource allocation, poor compatibility, poor scalability and performance bottlenecks, and puts forward a virtual model of security access, which uses high-performance packet processing framework, mature container cluster management framework, service computing node choreography, combined with the separation of data plane and control plane, virtualized data forwarding plane, realized the unified scheduling and management of hardware resources, the service of security access ability, and had the characteristics of high performance, high availability, flexible layout, strong scalability. The experimental results show that the model method can effectively and reasonably use hardware resources, and greatly improve the efficiency of secure access.

articleTitle: Leaf Image Semantic Segmentation Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to segment the leaf image under the complex background and improve the precision of segmentation. A leaf image semantic segmentation algorithm based on DeepLabv3+ network is proposed. The algorithm first labels the true value area of the leaf image, then sets the data augment and other preparation operations, and then uses resnet18, resnet50, mobilenetv2, xception and inceptionresnetv2 as the backbone network for training, and finally uses the trained network to segment on the test images. Experimental results show that MIOU of inresnetv2 can reach 90.3% on the leaf image dataset containing 300 images, which is better than other four backbone network segmentation algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Strategy for Transmission Capacity of Wind Farm Send-out Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The average value of the daily maximum of the highest temperature month is used as the basis for the temperature correction coefficient of the wind farm send-out transmission line to check and calculate the continuous limitation transmission capacity of the wind power transmission line under the allowable heating condition. Although it can better ensure the security operation of the transmission line, it is easy to cause the control margin of the transmission capacity of the line to be larger in other months where the temperature is far lower than the maximum temperature. In this paper, the temperature correction coefficient in different months with the average value of the daily maximum temperature of the month, wind power output characteristics, and the comprehensive allowable heating conditions continuous limitation transmission capacity calculation method from months to months are considered. An optimal control strategy for promoting the send-out line transmission capacity of the wind farm is proposed based on calculating the temperature correction coefficient accurately. Through the case study, it can be seen that the transmission capacity of wind power and utilization efficiency of the transmission line is improved by optimizing limitation transmission power of each month and giving full play to the transmission potential of the line of the wind farm in different months.

articleTitle: Research and application of power data management key technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the intensified application of power information systems and the advent of the “big data” era, higher requirements are put forward for power data resource management and power data security. Electric power companies have carried out research on key technologies for data management, established a three-level management system at the provincial, prefectural and county levels, built a panoramic view of data resources, a data operation management platform, a data negative list sharing mechanism, and a data security protection mechanism, which were applied to all aspects of data management and data governance. Through the support of business processes, data standards, data quality, etc., it has effectively improved the management efficiency of power data, improved the company's data management level, promoted business collaboration and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Holographic Technology in Aviation Detection Field
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aviation detection is mainly used for the performance inspection, damage assessment and judgment of airborne equipment and important parts, which falls under the category of aerial maintenance. The holographic technology is applied in the field of aviation detection, which can effectively carry out in-situ and non-destructive inspection, the aircraft parts are effectively protected, the unnecessary disassembly is avoided, and the detection methods are more flexible and diversified. This paper first analyzes the basic process and method of the realization of holographic technology, then analyzes in detail how to apply holographic non-destructive testing and holographic vibration testing to the field of aviation testing, and lays a foundation for the improvement of aviation detection technology.

articleTitle: The Application of Bayesian Network in Higher Vocational Students' Choice of Professional Direction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The grades of six courses of students in the class of 2020 in Chongqing Tourism Vocational College majoring in big data technology are taken as data samples, and the correlations among the six subjects are obtained by learning through bayesian network structure. Based on the Bayesian angiospectrum structure for parameter learning, the conditional probabilities of each discipline's grades are obtained; finally, the joint tree algorithm using bayesian network inference gives the students' grade prediction. The results show that it is feasible to make major direction selection based on the prediction results, which provides an important basis for departmental decision making and student direction selection.

articleTitle: Agent-based security protection model of secret-related carrier intelligent management and control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Secret-related carrier intelligent management and control system uses the Internet of Things and artificial intelligence to solve the transformation of secret-related carrier management and control from manual operation to automatic detection, precise monitoring, and intelligent decision-making, and use technical means to resolve security risks. However, the coexistence of multiple heterogeneous networks will lead to various network security problems in the secret carrier intelligent management and control. Aiming at the actual requirements of the intelligent management and control of secret-related carriers, this paper proposes a system structure including device domain, network domain, platform domain and user domain, and conducts a detailed system security analysis, and introduces intelligent agent technology, and proposes a distributed system. The hierarchical system structure of the secret-related carrier intelligent management and control security protection model has good robustness and portability.

articleTitle: Lifetime prognostics of lithium-ion battery pack based on its early cycling data and complete degradation information of battery cells
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Lifetime prognostics of lithium-ion batteries plays an important role in improving safety and reducing operation and maintenance costs in the field of energy storage. To rapidly evaluate the lifetime of newly developed battery packs, a method for estimating the future health state of the battery pack using the aging data of the battery cell's full life cycle and the early data of the battery pack is proposed. First, the battery cycle aging characteristics are analyzed from different perspectives. The health indicators (HIs) related to battery aging are extracted from the partial discharge process, and three HIs closely related to battery capacity aging are selected through the Pearson coefficient analysis method. Then, the HIs degradation model of the battery cell based on exponential fitting is corrected by the HIs in the early cycle of the battery pack to predict the HIs degradation curve of each cell in the battery pack in the future cycle. Finally, based on the Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) model, the battery pack's lifetime is predicted using the early 10% cycle data of the battery pack and the predicted HIs of the battery in remaining life cycle. The experimental results show that the mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) of the proposed method are 0.49% and 0.71%, respectively, which verify its advantages of high accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Touchless Control Technology Based on Inter-Satellite Electromagnetic Force
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Propellant consumption is the main factor limiting the service life of spacecraft in orbit. A spacecraft that runs out of fuel will lose its orbital maneuverability. Whether it is an effective spacecraft or a space debris, it needs external force to control its orbit. Traditional contact control methods, including mechanical arm capture, rope capture, etc., are at risk of collision and lack versatility. This paper proposes an integrated touchless orbit control scheme for spacecraft with electromagnetic coils and no inertial thrust. The active spacecraft with inertial thrust and electromagnetic coils is used to carry out touchless control of the target spacecraft. The inertial thrust changes the centroid motion of spacecraft formation. Electromagnetic force/torque keeps the relative position and relative attitude of spacecraft formation. Sliding mode control law is designed for inertial thrust to achieve the target satellite orbit control while maintaining the formation configuration. To reduce the accumulation of angular momentum caused by the geomagnetic field, an angular momentum management program based on current control was adopted, and the feasibility of the designed control program was verified through simulation calculations. It provides new ideas for the orbit correction of spacecraft and the de-orbit of failed spacecraft.

articleTitle: Adversarial Domain Adaptation via Class Correlation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Adversarial learning has been embedded in deep networks as a transferable representation of domain adaptation. The existing adversarial domain adaptation methods may not pay attention to the correlation between categories. In this paper, we propose an adversarial domain adaptation based on class correlation. In addition to the commonly used adversarial loss, we added a loss based on class correlation to reduce the probability of misclassification. We prevent the diversity of the network from decreasing by restricting the eigenvalues of the class correlation matrix.

articleTitle: Social-Aware Edge Caching in Double-layer distributed Fog Radio Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Fog Computing is a new variety of the cloud computing paradigm that brings virtualized cloud services to the edge of the network to control the devices in the IoT. Fog computing is implemented as an intermediate platform between end devices and cloud computing data centers. The recent popularity of the Internet of Things (IoT) has made fog computing a necessity to handle a variety of devices. It has been recognized as an important platform to provide efficient, location aware, close to the edge, cloud services. Fog radio access network(F-RAN) is a promising network architecture derived from fog computing. In this paper, we propose a device-to-device two-layer distributed cache model based on fog computing. First, we proposed a double-layer distributed cache model based on D2D communication and fog wireless access network, then we made one of the user equipments(DEs) to be central UE. The central UE can actively cache all the content of the fog node. When a UE applies for a file, it first applies to the central UE. If the central UE does not have one, it then applies to neighboring UEs in turn according to the priority of the sum of local content popularity which can reduce transmission delay. After a period of time, the buffer capacity in each UE is full. When there are new files to be cached, we propose a dynamic programming algorithm based on the knapsack problem, so that the files in each UE always have the largest sum of local content popularity. The simulation results show that this caching method can effectively reduce the transmission delay and the algorithm can improve the cache hate rate of files found in UE.

articleTitle: Analysis of signal strength attenuation of localizer at an airport in western China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Localizer is an important part of the instrument landing system(ILS), providing the horizontal guidance signal for aircraft precision approach. If the signal coverage of the localizer is not qualified, it may cause the restricted use, or it may cause the unavailability of the localizer and lead to the flight cannot land. In this paper, we combine the results of Flight inspection and obscuration angle plotting to find out what really cause the signal to be affected, and then analyzing whether they intrude into the Fresnel zone of the transceiver line through signal propagation theory, and calculate the signal attenuation value. It also provides an idea to analyze the signal of airport radio stations.

articleTitle: Overview of UAV Target Detection Algorithms Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the widespread use of UAVs in military struggles, how to take effective measures to achieve the detection of UAV targets has become a focus of attention in various countries. Obtaining target images based on photoelectric detection can overcome the shortcomings of traditional observation methods and effectively achieve detection and tracking for “low, slow, small” flying targets. In response to this problem, this article combines the development of target detection algorithms, discusses traditional target detection algorithms, two-stage and one-stage target detection algorithms based on deep learning, and summarize the advantages and disadvantages of different models based on the test results on the public data set.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Supervision and Application System of Food Traceability Based on Blockchain and Artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The lack of transparency in the production and circulation of commodities and the lack of corresponding supervision have led to endless problems such as food safety, counterfeit and shoddy products, loss and damage of commodities, and damage to the rights and interests of consumers. The traditional centralized database traceability monitoring system has serious problems of data trust, data fragmentation, difficulty in accountability, and low enthusiasm of merchants. In order to solve the traditional system problems, it is proposed to build an intelligent supervision system model for food traceability based on blockchain and artificial intelligence. Blockchain technology can effectively make up and improve the shortcomings of the existing commodity traceability technology, and achieve full process control and real-time storage. Forensic forensics, increase transparency, prevent counterfeiting, and increase consumer trust; AI uses industry-sharing data to perform big data analysis to guide companies in business decisions; at the same time, in order to increase user stickiness and increase the ecological environment of the platform, the article proposes to increase Blockchain and artificial intelligence and application ecology form a more practical and complete integrated system model of traceability, supervision and application. Finally, using FISCO BCOS as a blockchain platform development platform, the validity of the model is verified, and it can provide a certain reference for food traceability companies, software R&D companies, and government regulatory agencies.

articleTitle: Maximal Planar Graphs As Topological Authentications For Asymmetric Encryption
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: We, for asymmetric encryption, introduce colored topological authentication, Topcode-matrix authentication, cycle-coinciding operation, planar rhombus operation, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-subdivision operation, algorithms for some operations, uncolored/colored planar graph homomorphisms, uncolored/colored planar graph anti-homomorphisms, planar graphic lattices based on planar operation base, ß-colored planar graphic lattices based on ß-colored planar operation base, maximal planar graphic lattice, ß-colored maximal planar graphic lattice. We present the advantages of using maximal planar graphs in topological authentication.

articleTitle: Research on deep analysis technology of real time interaction protocol in power industrial control system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: with the continuous development of smart grid construction, the degree of automation of power system is improving rapidly, the number of sensors, the scale of information network and the number of decision-making units are greatly increased. The network security of power industry control system is facing severe challenges. This paper studies the deep analysis technology of real-time interactive protocol in power industrial control system, captures the data packet, analyzes the data packet layer by layer, obtains the field data stream of application layer, and realizes the deep analysis of IEC104 protocol, IEC61850 protocol and other power industrial control system protocols.

articleTitle: Smart Scheduling for Flexible and Hybrid Production with Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As a consequence of growing personalized consumption, the demand for customized production processes is steadily increasing. Therefore, production systems should have a flexible structure, redundant resources, and dynamic scheduling mechanism to incorporate hybrid production of small-lot or even one-item orders. A greater flexibility will result in a higher uncertainty of production performance which can be mitigated by the introduction of smart scheduling mechanisms. In this paper, the scheduling problem of flexible and hybrid production is modelled as a workpiece-machine and workpiece-workpiece interaction problem. As an approach to problem solving, the Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning algorithm is applied. Simulation results confirm that the scheduling algorithm converges in the training process resulting in a clear performance improvement with respect to processing time.

articleTitle: Intelligent investigating technology for abnormal operation of wiring terminals of electric energy metering device based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Safe and accurate operation of electric energy metering device is crucial to the fairness of the electric power transaction and the safety of customers' electricity consumption. Abnormal wiring terminals are one of the main reasons for the failure of the electric energy metering device. Therefore, it is necessary to check the status of the wiring terminals of the operating electric energy metering device.In view of the current artificial mode electric energy metering device wiring terminal screen low speed, low accuracy and high security risk, and the abnormal electric energy metering device discovery, screening and management difficult problems, this paper puts forward a kind of electric energy metering device based on the deep learning terminals running abnormal intelligent screening technology,By abnormal construction of the library and image enhancement, than recognition step, quick and comprehensive implementation of wrong wiring terminals, such as nonstandard connections are not reliable, installation of abnormal intelligence screening and rapid diagnosis, significantly increased the site tour and safety inspections of work efficiency and quality, guarantee the safe and stable operation of electric energy metering device.

articleTitle: ETM fusion algorithm based on log classification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the improvement of computer computing power, the shortcomings of the computational inefficiency of the genetic mining algorithm are compensated, and the genetic mining become a research hotspot. In this paper, for the Evolutionary Tree Miner (ETM) algorithm in noise processing can not find the low-frequency effective path and remove the shortage of noise, an ETM fusion algorithm based on log classification is proposed. The algorithm performs process model mining for high-frequency and low-frequency logs separately, and get model fusion based on alignment ideas, Eventually mining the complete process model. Through the simulation of event log data verification, the improved algorithm achieves more complete process model mining than the original ETM algorithm.

articleTitle: A Study for Obstacle Determination fusing MMW Radar and Vision Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper, on the basis of attention mechanism and driver's visual consciousness, presented a robust and adaptive approach for on-road obstacle boundary detection through fusing vision sensor and millimeter wave (MMW) radar in order to implement the navigation task, which is the sequent research work of radar and vision fusion for autonomous ground vehicle (AGV) navigation. It is the first most important issue for practically real-time precise guidance, navigation and control (GNC) of AGV. The novel exploration of prior knowledge about the features, shadow and edge or the position indicator lamps was discussed and employed with the attentive information from millimeter wave radar. An adaptive threshold algorithm based on the local significant peak and trough inside peaks determination (LSiPTiD) of the gray image histogram was provided in order to automatically judge the validity of obstacle shadow detection and detect the obstacle robustly. Vertical edge detection and possible intensity mutant were integrated with shadow and radar vision fusion point so as to recognize obstacle boundary correctly and robustly for further GNC task. In the end, through huge experiments of real on-road measured data, the algorithm was verified to be robust, adaptive and fast for real-time applications in natural road environment.

articleTitle: Next-item Recommendation with Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer and Matrix Factorization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The next-item recommendation is a task based on sequential nature of users' behaviors. Existing approaches employ sequential neural networks with users' historical interactions for predicting next-item. However, these methods have the limitations including: (a) traditional unidirectional architectures overemp-hasize a rigidly order between items among sequence which is not always necessarily; (b) they often take users' short-term preferences from users' transient interests into consideration while neglect users' long-term intentions. In fact, consumers' purchasing intensions are not only affected by their recent preferences, but also by their long-term preferences for certain items. To this end, we propose a sequential recommendation model for next-item called BERTMF, which takes both users' recent intentions and long-term preferences into account for next-item recommendation. For users' current intentions, we employ bidirectional encoder representations from transformer (BERT) to model users' behavior sequences. To address users' diverse behavioral intentions tendency, attention mechanism is embedded into users' short-term intentions representations. In this work, we propose a generalized matrix factorization (GMF) method to model users' long-term interests and target it to the attention mechanism. As users' current intentions are changing and relative to users and target item, we introduce a fusion layer to better model both users' sequential behaviors and long-term intention representations. In the experiments on public datasets, our approach outperforms various origin next-item recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Research and application of secondary system intelligence inspection technology based on data source transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the continuous increase of equipment scale in the substation secondary system, the manual inspection of the secondary system presents the characteristics of low efficiency, weak effect and so on. The insufficiency of carrying capacity of operational inspection and professional inspection personnel is becoming more and more prominent. It is urgent to study the intelligent inspection technology of the substation secondary system and promote the inspection mode from traditional manual inspection to intelligent inspection. This paper proposes a differentiated intelligent operational strategy for secondary system based on data source transformation without blind spots, the inspection data accumulation model and the trend prediction method of equipment status. Relying on the existing data network architecture and transmission channels, and integrating intelligent inspection technologies such as multi-source data acquisition and cleaning, status trend prediction and analysis, customized interaction of inspection tasks, etc., the intelligent panoramic perception and intelligent operation and maintenance system of the secondary equipment status were constructed to realize the efficient and accurate intelligent inspection of the secondary system. Related technologies have been successfully applied to the intelligent inspection of the substation secondary system in the 2022 Beijing - Zhangjiakou Winter Olympic Games, significantly improving the reliability and timeliness of inspection data and significantly reducing inspection costs.

articleTitle: An Improved Deep Pairwise Supervised Hashing Algorithm for Fast Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, hashing algorithm has been widely researched and has made considerable progress in large-scale image retrieval tasks due to its advantages of convenient storage and fast calculation efficiency. Nowadays most researchers use deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to perform feature learning and hash coding learning at the same time for image retrieval and the deep hashing methods based on deep CNNs perform much better than the traditional manual feature hashing methods. But most methods are designed to handle simple binary similarity and decrease quantization error, ignoring that the features of similar images and hashing codes generated are not compact enough. In order to enhance the performance of CNNs-based hashing algorithms for large scale image retrieval, this paper proposes a new deep-supervised hashing algorithm in which a novel channel attention mechanism is added and the loss function is elaborately redesigned to generate compact binary codes. It experimentally proves that, compared with the existing hashing methods, this method has better performance on two large scale image datasets CIFAR-10 and NUS-WIDE.

articleTitle: Graph elements of banknotes of the Republic of China detection and recognition based on deep learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of banknotes of the Republic of China to be classified in the museum and the difficulty of establishing a banknote database, a small sample of Republic of China banknote graph elements detection and recognition model based on YOLO v4 algorithm was proposed. Created a specific dataset based on images provided by the museum, and enhance difficult data. Extended the application of the target detection algorithm based on deep learning to the field of banknote cultural relics. In our dataset, the mean Average Precision (mAP) of this modal reaches 91.83%, which is improved by 21.12%, 10.65%, 12.70% compared with SSD algorithm, YOLO v3 algorithm, and Faster R-CNN algorithm. The detection time of a single image at 0.37s. Experimental results show that the proposed modal can achieve efficient and accurate positioning detection of the elements of the Republic of China banknote graph. Lay the foundation for the cultural relics sorting, clustering, and the establishment of a banknote retrieval system.

Author Keywords: banknote of the Republic of China

articleTitle: An Improved Association Analysis Method Based on Previous and Latter Constraint for Transmission Section Overload
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Once the large-capacity ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission system has a blocking failure, a series of control measures are implemented to fill the power shortage of the receiving-end power grid. Focus on the problem of overloaded transmission sections after primary and secondary frequency modulation, this paper proposes an improved association analysis method and adjustment strategy based on previous and latter constraint for transmission section overload. Firstly, Using dynamic power flow algorithm to simulate blocking faults and the transmission sections are adjusted by sensitivity method. Then, the adjustment information is extracted, after data processing, the database of unit, load adjustment strategies and section state change is set up, the algorithm is improved that fore-part item-set is restricted to be the unit and load adjustment strategy and rear-part item-set is restricted to be the change of the section state. The strong association rules between the adjustment strategy and the change of the section state are analyzed. Finally, the results of DC fault simulation and association analysis show that the improved method greatly reduces the generation of invalid rules, and the strong association rules effective for section adjustment are extracted from association analysis, which provides decision-making basis for overloaded transmission section adjustment of the power grid.

articleTitle: Study on Terrain Matching Method Based on Cater Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Chang'e-4 lunar probe carrying the Moon Rabbit 2 lunar rover was lifted off by the Long March 3B launch vehicle and landed on the back side of the Moon after 26 days of space flight, becoming the world's first probe to land on the back side of the Moon. In this paper, a terrain matching method based on crater detection is designed using the images taken by Chang'e-4 on the back side of the Moon. This method firstly establishes a local land marker library based on the existing data and the intended landing area of the spacecraft, then identifies and labels the craters in the images taken by the landing camera, and finally matches the craters in the captured images with the data in the land marker library to obtain the position information of the spacecraft during the landing process.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Urban Rail Transit Smart Station
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of urban rail transit, stations gradually form an industry trend from meeting the basic needs of an operation to intelligent development. This paper, through the study of smart stations, breaks the barriers of data interconnection between current equipment systems, and more importantly, redefines the service functions of the stations, understands the new needs of passengers and operation management, and optimizes the architecture design, functional structure and network structure of the control platform. Taking the centralized and visualized one-button switching station function adopted in the control platform as an example, it shows that the research on smart stations greatly saves the time of opening and closing stations in operation management and improves the automation of station equipment. These studies are of great significance to the construction and development of smart stations and can also provide a reference for the construction of smart stations in other cities.

articleTitle: Threat Evaluation Method of Social Network Nodes Based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for evaluating the threat of social network nodes based on Particle Swarm optimization (PSO), including in the assessment of node anomaly degree and node influence, the assessment of node influence pays more attention to the ability of nodes to disseminate information on social platforms, and the PSO is selected to determine the parameters involved in the calculation. Finally, combined with the calculated node anomaly score, the final node threat degree is obtained. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this study can increase the spearman rank correlation coefficient between the expected value of tweets to be reposted calculated in the previous study and the actual reposting situation from the original highest 0.5599 to 0.6129. Comparing the results calculated by this method with the results of the PageRank algorithm, the reliability of the method is verified.

articleTitle: A Coarse-fine Optimization Method for Blank Localization of Complex Surfaces based on 3D Point Clouds
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a new optimization method combining coarse and fine optimization is proposed based on 3D point clouds, which provides a solution to the blank localization problem of complex surface parts. The coarse-fine optimization method proposed in this paper consists of two steps: coarse optimization and fine optimization. In coarse optimization stage, the large minimum allowance space is obtained by the unconstrained max-min criterion, so that the machinability of the blank can be judged. In fine optimization stage, the reasonable specific constraint value is determined according to the minimum margin distance, and the least square criterion with constraints is used to ensure the uniform distribution of margin. Finally, the effectiveness of the coarse-fine optimization method is verified by two examples. Results show that the proposed method can overcome the limitations of the existing methods, and obtain good optimization performance. Keywords-blank localization; coarse-fine optimization; 3D point clouds; complex surfaces

articleTitle: A Hybrid Deep Neural Network Model for Stock Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a hybrid deep neural network model (HDNNM) to predict the stock price. The HDNNM consists of two parts: classification and regression. The classification part utilizes convolutional neural network (CNN) to build a three - category classification model, which aims to predict whether the trend of stock in next day is up, flat or down. Then according to the result of the classification, data of different trends are fed into their corresponding regression models based on CNN-long short-term memory (CNN-LSTM), which aims to put the features extracted from CNN into LSTM for the price spread prediction. Finally, the predicted price spread plus close price of the day is the close price of next day. The proposed model was compared and verified by Standard & Poor's 500 (S&P 500) index, a stock index of 500 publicly traded companies in the United States. We evaluate the experiments by four technical indicators and the results show that the proposed method has better performance compared with other models.

articleTitle: Factory Operating System (FOS): Vertical Integration Framework for Smart Factories
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The vertical integration of shop-floor resources used to build smart factories is among the key factors of the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT). The primary IIoT enablers are the emerging technologies that have been arising from computer and data science, information and communication technology, and artificial intelligence and machine learning domain. However, existing architectures such as Cyber Physical Production System are rather abstract and with technology preferences. In this paper, a technology-neutral framework called Factory Operating System (FOS) was proposed. The similarity between the FOS and computer Operating System (OS) was discussed first to establish the easy-to-understand background. Then, the main functions and common FOS services were identified and defined. Furthermore, potentially compatible technologies were examined alongside FOS, allowing for technical gaps and overlaps to be detected. The outlook of the FOS application scenarios based on the UniqueCandy prototype and the FOS scalability to support production networks was assessed. Finally, the obtained results validate that FOS can be used both as a practical vision and an applicable framework for the vertical integration of smart factories.

articleTitle: Analysis of Effective Application of Information Extraction Method for Online Product Reviews Based on User Experience
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at product design improvement, a collection and analysis method of user experience information in online product reviews was proposed.First, an user experience element model was constructed.Then, according to the element model, the user emotion, product feature and usage context in a single review sentence were extracted step by step. Finally, the user experience elements extracted from a single review sentence were classified and integrated, and through quantitative analysis of the review data, the product features and use contexts that have a greater impact on user experience were identified. The method was verified by taking the online reviews of a smart phone on Jingdong-Mall as the example. The experimental results show that the method can effectively extract the user experience elements from online product reviews, identify the product features and use contexts that have a great impact on the user experience, and assist designers to improve the product design.

articleTitle: Self-adaptive Adjustment System for Swing Speed of Boom-type Roadheader
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As the main equipment of the coal mining industry, the boom-type roadheader's tunneling efficiency is mainly affected by the power of the cutting motor. In the traditional coal mining process, sudden changes in the hardness of the coal and rock will cause the power of the cutting motor to oscillate, thereby reducing the operating efficiency of the roadheader. In order to solve the problem of the power oscillation of the cutting motor when the coal hardness changes suddenly, a roadheader swing speed adjustment system is designed. The system mainly stabilizes the power of the cutting motor by adjusting the swing speed of the cantilever. The system first introduced the sliding window algorithm to solve the problem of BP neural network forgetting historical samples, and then used the BP neural network algorithm to optimize PID control, construct a BP-PID controller, and finally use the cutting current as the basis for sudden changes in coal hardness. The control performance of BP-PID control based on sliding window is simulated and analyzed. The results show that the BP neural network PID control system based on sliding window can quickly adjust the swing speed, stabilize the cutting motor power, reduce the oscillation amplitude, have better adaptability, and has more superior control performance than a single PID control system.

articleTitle: Data-Augumention Strategy For Small-Footprint Keyword Spotting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Due to the complex and variable environments of keyword spotting in real usage scenarios, there are multiple interference factors such as point-source noises, reverberation, background noises, dynamic changes in speaker's speed and volume. However, the current open source speech dataset lacks real data in such specific application scenarios. To solve this problem, we propose an efficient data modeling method in the real environment to process the data in the open source dataset to simulate the real use environment, so as to improve the robustness of the keyword spotting models. We evaluated our proposed data-augmentation strategy on the Mobvoihotwords dataset. Our results show that compared with the baseline system, the false rejection rate is reduced by 5.1% under the premise of a fixed false alarm per hour.

articleTitle: Multi-wave Missile Fire Strike Transportation Route Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article studies the overall decision-making and maneuver route planning in multi-wave missile launching. The research content includes launching point selection, reloading point allocation, route planning and schema optimization of multi-wave missile launch missions. According to the actual battlefield situation, we built the multi-wave missile launch mission path planning model. We adopt the comprehensive algorithm based on cluster analysis and Dijkstra's shortest path, then use the method of step-by-step discussion to solve each parameter in turn, and introduce information entropy for global optimization. Finally we select the best solution and verify the validity of the model through an example.

articleTitle: Microalgae dimming system based on optical communication
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a kind of microalgae dimming system based on visible light communication technology is designed. The transreceiver of the visible light communication module is set up on LED illuminating system and photobioreactor of microalgae culture laboratory. Meanwhile, the light intensity and light time of the current microalgae culture can be displayed on the touch screen of microalgae photobioreactor. Researchers can also adjust the lighting environment required by the computer, which can provide a more suitable culture environment for microalgae.

articleTitle: Study and Application of Control Strategy for Steadying Frequency of Isolated Grid Based on Main Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Isolated grid is a special operation mode of power system in extreme circumstances. most control system of power plant do not fully consider this function, usually, the proportion of thermal power units in isolated grid is large, and the self-balancing ability is poor, the smaller power imbalance will cause greater frequency fluctuation, and even cause power grid collapse. This paper analyses the instability of isolated grid, drawing lessons from the multiple collapses of an isolated grid, puts forward a control strategy of steadying frequency based on main units, including OPC differentiation, reduce load rapidly in high frequency, distribute load reduction of main units, etc. Through practical application, it is clear that the main units use different control strategies automatically balance the supply and demand relationship of the grid when the power grid oscillates, so that the grid can be balanced in a short time, which has a good reference.

articleTitle: A method of test sinusoids generation for high-power electromechanical servo system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article introduces a method to generate test sinusoidal signals for high-power electromechanical servo system. By discretizing standard sinusoidal signals, this method generates the overflow rate data of the timer, and uses the single-chip microcomputer to control the stepping motor to drive the auto-angler to rotate, to generate the test sinusoidal signalS required by the high-power electromechanical servo system. The test results show that the method can meet the test requirements of the follow-up system, and can modify the parameters of the input sinusoidal signals.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm of Weaponry Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Nowadays, modern warfare has changed from weapon-centric operations to network-centric system operations, which has led to the phenomenon of sea-level quantification of weaponry. It is an important research topic for combat commanders to select suitable weaponry from a large number of available resources when facing combat tasks. Recommendation technology is a solution to this problem, which can effectively solve the problem of information overload, so that combat commanders do not produce the phenomenon of “information loss”, in the shortest possible time to make the right decision. Therefore, this paper proposes a collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm for weaponry based on the knowledge graph and the idea of collaborative filtering. In this algorithm, the knowledge graph provides a clear data model with various association relationships, and the collaborative filtering algorithm can realize it without relying on professional experience, which can realize the recommendation process more actively, faster and more intelligently.

articleTitle: Research on Data Mining Algorithm of Power Grid Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: There are a large amount of complex data in the power grid database. How to use these data reasonably and efficiently and solve the problem of power grid operation safety has become an urgent need.
