Based on the principle of association rule mining technology, this paper realizes the mining of the potential information of the massive data of the power grid database through the improved Apriori algorithm., The improved algorithm innovation introduces two factors of efficiency and interest, so that strong association rules can be screened more accurately. In addition, in view of the large number of candidate sets of the Apriori algorithm, which is not conducive to the shortcomings of later convergence, an early pruning mechanism is introduced. Thereby improving the efficiency of the algorithm for mining information. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of the method are verified through experiments.

articleTitle: A new MHT algorithm for small UAV considering micro Doppler characteristic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of target tracking for small rotor UAV, a new MHT algorithm considering micro Doppler characteristic is proposed. The micro Doppler characteristic of the UAV is extracted from radar echoes, and the MHT algorithm is used to filter the micro Doppler characteristic whose filtering score is calculated meanwhile. The weighted sum of the micro Doppler characteristic filtering score and the target trace filtering score is used as the final track score for track management. Simulation results show that the tracking stability of the algorithm in this paper is better than the traditional MHT algorithm, the algorithm in this paper reduces the loss of tracking rate from 4.68% of the traditional MHT algorithm to 1.14%, and the position RMS error from about 100m of the traditional MHT algorithm to about 60m.

articleTitle: Direct Torque Control of Five-Phase Surface Permanent Magnet Motor Based on Fuzzy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of modern power electronics technology and manufacturing process of rare earth permanent magnet materials, multiphase permanent magnet motor has been widely used in aerospace, ship and other fields. Compared with the three-phase motor, five-phase surface permanent magnet motor has the advantages of redundant phase number, more control resources and better control performance. In view of the disadvantages of the traditional direct torque control in flux and torque ripple, the fuzzy controller is proposed to replace the traditional hysteresis. At the same time, aiming at the characteristic that zero vectors are used to reduce the torque and flux ripple to a greater extent, the simulation results prove the feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: The Technical Research of In Situ Diagnoses of Engine Start Electrical Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: It is always a puzzle reflected by the user that the high failure rate of a certain engine start system with shortage of maintenance methods. Based on the analysis of logic control relationship and requirements of electrical parameters measurement of engine start electrical control system, the rule database and fact database based on fault model are constructed by using FMEA. And the methods are achieved by using of PCI bus control, data acquisition and processing, Windows software programming in order to diagnose and measure the logical relationship of engine start system and typical electrical parameters in situ automatically. Eventually the automatic test platform is running fast and convenient, accurate and reliable, which can provide support for fault diagnosis and intelligent maintenance decisions.

articleTitle: Discussion of Wireless Transmission Module in Intelligent Products
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Wireless transmission module was an important information transfer module in mangy circuits. There are two usual types of wireless modules. One is Zigbee technology. The other is blue teeth module. In computation, Zigbee was much faster than blue teeth in transferring data. Though the former technology was more advantageous than the latter in long distance transferring data, the former was higher than the latter in power consumption. In the aspect of stability and reliability, blue technology was more advantageous than Zigbee technology. These two different technologies have variable connections with 51 single chips. They were more useful in teaching students to study wireless technology and information transfer. Zigbee technology has the characters of short distance, low complexity, self-organization, low power consumption, low data rate, and low cost.

articleTitle: Design of a circuit for a smart seat adjustment system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A system is designed and implemented that can adjust the seat height according to the user's height. Its main functions are as follows: First, according to the seat users' height that input by the user, the system can obtain the best seat height through analysis, and automatically rise or fall to this height. Second, the system can automatically detect the length of time of using the chair and give an alarm according to the standard of sedentary time. The hardware of this system consists of distance measure module, pressure detection module, motor drive module, key and display module. The main control chip used in this system is STC89C52, and an ultrasonic sensor is HC-SR04 as the ranging part. According to the designed circuit, the hardware is installed, the software is debugged, and the expected functions are realized.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Test System of Relay Protection Device in Digital Intelligent Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The relay protection device in intelligent substation is of great significance to the stable operation of the power system. The key technology of automatic test system for relay protection device in digital intelligent substation is analyzed, and the design idea and process of automatic test system are discussed and analyzed, which can be used as a reference for power system staff and reduce the workload.

articleTitle: Blind obstacle avoidance system based on improved YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to facilitate outdoor travel for blind people, this paper proposes a blind person's obstacle avoidance system based on the improved YOLOv3 algorithm. The system design is based on C/S architecture, the user device consists of STM32F103, serial module, camera module, 4G module, etc.; the server software system mainly includes two parts: data sending and receiving and target detection. First of all, the pictures taken by the camera module are stored in the data buffer, and the 4G module is used to transmit the picture data to the server, after the server receives the picture data, it will be reduced to pictures, and then the trained F-YOLOv3 model is used to detect the pictures, and if an obstacle is detected, the result will be returned to STM32F103, and STM32F103 will output this result to the user by voice, so as to achieve the purpose of obstacle avoidance. The STM32F103 will output this result to the user, thus achieving the purpose of obstacle avoidance. In this paper, we propose an improved F-YOLOv3 based on YOLOv3, which increases the original 3 feature scales in YOLOv3 to 4, thus reducing the miss detection rate of small target objects; replaces some convolutional layers in Darknet53 with improved deep separable convolutional blocks. The depth-separable convolutional block in Darknet53 is replaced with an improved depth-separable convolutional block, which speeds up the detection speed.

articleTitle: Automatic Model Association Method of Three-Dimensional Model and Monitoring,Control and Management Model of Electric Equipments
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To realize data display in the three-dimensional visualization system of electric equipment, it is necessary to build a three-dimensional data model and interact with the data source. The accurate association of models is the basis of information exchange between different systems. The paper proposes a fast and automatic correlation modeling method for the 3D visualization model and monitoring management model of electric equipment. Firstly, the conceptual model of monitoring management and three-dimensional visualized knowledge graph is constructed of the electric equipment. Secondly, supplement the knowledge graph data based on the data of actual equipment and application system. In association modeling, knowledge search based on ontology features is used to realize automatic association of model information. An example is illustrated with oil transformer equipment, a knowledge graph based on transformer and its components is constructed as the basis for the correlation of transformer equipment models between different systems.

articleTitle: RO PUF Design in FPGAs with Frequency-Offsetting Strategies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Ring Oscillator Physical Unclonable Function (RO PUF) is an efficient and safe identification and authentication security primitive. However, since the RO oscillation frequency may be related to the type of FPGA used, its safety is difficult to guarantee. Based on the Spartan-3E S500 of Xilinx, this article summarizes the characteristics of the RO frequency distribution in the RO array and proposes a frequency compensation strategy. Combining the two existing comparison strategies, the safety of RO PUF before and after using the frequency compensation strategy is evaluated from the two perspectives of the average bit average probability of being successfully predicted and the information entropy density. Experimental results show that the frequency compensation strategy can greatly improve the safety of RO PUF.

articleTitle: Stability of A Class of Neutral Stochastic dynamical system of nonconvolution type with variable delay
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The stochastic dynamical system driven by Brownian motion has been widely used in neural networks and genetic engineering. In this paper, we consider the asymptotically stability in mean square of a kind of neutral stochastic dynamical system of nonconvolution type by means of fixed point method. The theorems of asymptotically stability in mean square with necessary conditions are proved. Some results of related papers are improved.

Author Keywords: neutral stochastic dynamical system of nonconvolution type with variable delay

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Audio Encoder Based on Zynq
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This experiment uses ZYNQ-7000 series products to design the audio encoder under the local area network to realize the conversion function from audio stream to IP stream. On the ZYNQ platform, it can not only give play to the advantages of FPGA parallel computing, but also have the flexibility of the processor system, which can realize high-speed data acquisition and real-time processing. In this system, the software and hardware coordination method are adopted to realize the continuous cycle generation of data sources on the PL side, and the AXI-DMA IP core is used to store the data in the DDR, and operating system on the PS side reads the data in the DDR and compresses the audio through the FFmpeg library and pushes it to SRS, and finally uses the VLC player to pull the stream to achieve the effects of encoding, pushing and playing. The construction of this system has certain practical significance for the on-demand audio program.

articleTitle: Camouflage Target Detection Based on SSD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Camouflage targets are highly integrated with the background, and there are problems of low detection accuracy and high detection difficulty with traditional detection methods. In this paper, the SSD network in one stage detection algorithm is applied to the detection of camouflage targets to explore the detection effect of using deep learning on camouflage targets, and it is validated on the military camouflage personnel dataset, and the experimental results show that the SSD algorithm can be well applied to the detection of camouflage targets with an average detection accuracy of 63.16%.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a star map recognition method based on drawing auxiliary lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the complex problem of the frame difference algorithm in the target tracking of small targets in space, considering the practical application of the camera array system in target tracking, the time when the camera array system uses the target trajectory tracking function is to track the small target in space, so this paper proposes a target point position prediction trajectory tracking algorithm improves the efficiency of target trajectory tracking by predicting and tracking the centroid of the observation point. Compared with the frame difference method for target tracking, the efficiency of using this algorithm for tracking is much higher.

articleTitle: Study on the calculation of the best rotation period of electronic equipment war storage materials based on economic life
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Itis an important prerequisite to scientifically measure the rotation period of electronic equipment war storage materials to improve the efficiency of war storage rotation. In view of the rapid development of electronic equipment technology, it is difficult to measure the technical intangible loss of war storage materials. Using the idea of equipment economic life for reference, this paper studies the best rotation period of electronic equipment war storage materials. Firstly, this paper introduces the idea of calculating the best rotation period of electronic equipment war storage materials based on economic life. Secondly, the calculation model of the best rotation period of electronic equipment war storage materials based on economic life is constructed. Finally, taking the war storage materials of one electronic equipment as an example to verified and analyzed.

articleTitle: Random Feedback Control for Transverse Vibration of Axially Moving Rectangular Film
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: It is generally believed that the control system is not subject to random interference. In fact, engineering systems are more or less subject to random interference, and it is often impossible to obtain all the information of the state, but only some incomplete information can be obtained according to the measurement equation. Based on the previous research, this paper considers the random system with noise in the system measurement device. Through Kalman filter, the linear optimal estimation of the system state is obtained according to the deterministic input of the system and the random measurement output with noise, and the estimated state is used to replace the real state of the system for linear feedback control of the axially moving rectangular membrane. By combining Kalman filter with stochastic state regulator and designing optimal state feedback at the same time, the system with measurement noise output can achieve the optimal control effect.

articleTitle: Packet Forwarding Authentication Method Based on Pre-sequence in SDN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Packet forwarding authentication is an important challenge in the field of Software-Defined Network (SDN) security. Aiming at the lack of effective packet sampling model and consistency verification mechanism in the current SDN network, this paper presents a packet forwarding authentication method based on pre-sequence. Firstly, the sampling range is restricted according to the random generation function and the characteristic information of the packet, packet sampling model is established, and the data stream is randomly marked. Secondly, design a method to dynamically adjust the identification probability based on the pre-sequence to reduce the packet authentication overhead in the network, and establish a packet inspection information database through a unified formal description language, so as to realize the integrity measurement of the packet according to the identification sequence mapping matching result, to ensure the effectiveness of packet consistency conflict detection. Finally, performance evaluation through simulation experiments is conducted. The results show that this method can effectively solve security threats such as packet forwarding, tampering and forgery while introducing 10.2% overhead.

articleTitle: Research on Image Fuzzy Threshold Segmentation Algorithm based on Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In view of the fuzzy and uncertain characteristics of the image to be segmented, the combination of fuzzy theory and threshold image segmentation is selected for image segmentation. In this paper, the filtering method is selected. The threshold is determined by the maximum inter class variance method. The gray similarity and spatial similarity between the pixel and its neighboring pixels are expressed by the weighted value method. Then the membership function of the target and background is determined by the normalized synthesis. Finally, the optimal segmentation threshold is obtained by fuzzy entropy, The reasonable division of image object and background is realized.

articleTitle: Operational Effectiveness Evaluation of Reconnaissance Satellite System based on System Dynamics Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to study changes in the effectiveness of reconnaissance satellite system (RSS) in supporting maritime operations, based on the key factors of dynamic confrontation system of the offensive and defensive parties, the feedback relationships between variables are analyzed. According to the feedback relationship, a system dynamics (SD) model based on Lanchester equation was established and simulated on the VENSIM platform to compare and analyze operational effectiveness of different RSS allocation schemes. Simulation analysis shows that RSS can increase the rate of detection and acquisition of information and accelerate the loss of the enemy. At the same time, when the sensor parameters are similar, increasing the number of weapons can significantly reduce the loss, which provides a certain theoretical support for decision-making analysis in combat.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Live Stream System Based on Kurento
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The traditional live stream technology has a large latency. In order to obtain more effective interaction between the presenter and the audience, this paper designs and implements a low latency live stream platform based on Kurento. The core architecture is based on Kurento, which is also a combination of WebRTC Media Server and a set of APIs. We use Spring Boot as the framework of application server, and WebSocket protocol and JSON format for signaling channel. We choose the Derby database to store the data. The platform breaks through geographical restrictions, and uses UDP protocol to push the stream to reduce the delay of live stream. This not only improves the interaction efficiency between the presenter and the audience, but also solves the shortcomings of the traditional live stream system to a certain extent. In addition, the cross-platform characteristic of WebRTC makes video live stream more flexible and simpler, which can be used as a reference for the rapid development of similar live stream businesses.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of User Behavior Simulation Technology Based on Power Industry Cyber Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The current cyber range of the electric power industry has background traffic simulation problems, prospect behavior generation problems, and target simulation diversity problems in large-scale network environments. In response to these problems, this paper proposes a user behavior simulation technology suitable for power industry cyber range. We perform large-scale, high-fidelity network user behavior simulation by combining real traffic playback, inject user behavior traffic in the real network into the virtual target network, then model the user behavior in multiple scenarios in the power network space and generate it based on the method of sequence prediction, and finally realize the diversity simulation of user behavior.

articleTitle: Research on Mask Wearing Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The current mask wearing detection device is affected by numerous factors, such as the large number of people in complex scenes, the easy obstruction of the gathering crowd, and the small size of the inspection target, which are prone to false detections and missing inspections. In order to solve the above problems, this journal proposed a mask-wearing detection algorithm based on YOLOv5 to realize real-time detection in complex scenes. Firstly, perform Mosaic data enhancement and other processes on the data set. Then, apply Focus process to retain more complete down sampling information of the images for subsequent feature extraction. Later, employ SPP to integrate multi-scale information to achieve feature enhancement and retain spatial information within Neck. Finally, CIoU Loss function is selected s to improve the positioning accuracy. And during the training process, a dynamic adjustment strategy is adopted for the learning rate.Experimental results show that the average accuracy of the improved algorithm reaches 99.1%.

articleTitle: Frequency and Voltage Regulation Strategy of Microgrid Based on Energy Storage Virtual Synchronous Generator Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The application of virtual synchronous generator (VSG) in new energy grid connected power generation and microgrid application has become a research hotspot. When VSG technology is used for primary frequency regulation control of energy storage, it can be not solved the possibility that the frequency and voltage of microgrid will change greatly. Due to sudden increase or drop of load or adjustment of new energy power generation power under isolated operation mode of microgrid which will eventually lead to failure of microgrid re-grid operation. The secondary frequency modulation control is proposed to reestablish the active power frequency balance point and reactive power voltage balance point of the microgrid system under the island operation mode. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by building a simulation model of wind, light and storage combined microgrid on the simulation platform.

articleTitle: Accelerator for Sparse Convolutional Neural Networks Based on Shift Units
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), deeper and wider networks improve accuracy while increasing deployment difficulty. Design lightweight algorithms and high-efficiency hardware accelerators has therefore become a research hotspot. In this article, the sparsity and quantized weights of CNNs are explored in the quest to obtain lightweight models that decrease the number of weights to 28% and bit widths to 25% compared with original models. To avoid unbalanced computation, we model sparse CNNs and propose a data flow with high processing element (PE)-utilization ratio and low DRAM-access amount. We design a sparse CNN accelerator based on shift units, in which the zero weights are skipped to save execution time and energy. The layout was taped out in TSMC 28 nm and packaged with QFP144. Passing the functional tests, the design achieves 256.1GOPS performance and gains 1.133TOPS/W efficiency. Compared with similar designs, our design achieves 46.7% less EDP.

articleTitle: Research on 5G Network Evaluation System for the Power Scenario
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The power communication network is the fundamental for ensuring the security and stability of the power system, whose quality significantly impacts the production, management, and dispatch of the power system. Therefore, it is of great significance to develop a reasonable wireless network evaluation system for the power scenario. In this paper, we first modeled a 5G network quality evaluation index for power scenario, including coverage, performance, and security, which is based on the network requirements of general links in power industry. Then, we put forward the principles of the evaluation system and the methods of quantifying indicators. Finally, this paper presents an index weight calculation algorithm, which can embody the importance of each index objectively and comprehensively.

articleTitle: Method of Micro-motion Feature Extraction of Rotor Target in Time Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of parameter estimation of rotor target, a method of speed estimation of rotor target echo in time domain with the characteristics in signal amplitude variation is proposed. Firstly, the scattering point echo model of rotor target is established, and the characteristics of echo in time domain are analyzed. Secondly, support vector machine (SVM), nearest neighbor algorithm (KNN) and naive Bayes (NB) algorithm are used to estimate the rotor speed of the target with 3 rotor blades under the condition of partial missing signals of different SNRs. Finally, the simulation results are analyzed to evaluate the feasibility of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the rotor speed can be estimated in time domain according to the micro-motion signal of rotor target echo, and it has good effect under certain conditions.

articleTitle: Equivalent modeling and analysis of three-phase LCL grid-connected inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Solar energy is one of the hot spots in the field of new energy because of its infinite and clean characteristics. As the most significant application of solar energy, photovoltaic power generation has become the key technology of competing research in various countries. Inverter is the interface of solar system to power grid, and it is an important part of conversion of DC to AC, MPPT, filtering and reducing output power fluctuation. Grid connection control is the key to realize grid connection of inverter to meet the requirements of grid connection. Therefore, the paper analyzes the working characteristics of photovoltaic cells, and establishes the mathematical model of photovoltaic array according to the I-V mathematical function of photovoltaic cells. In addition, based on the structure and working principle of the inverter main circuit, the mathematical model of inverter is deduced by establishing circuit equation. Finally, the coupling of inverter control system is analyzed in different coordinate systems, and the accuracy of the model is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on malicious Program Traffic Detection Technology based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the implementation of the strategy of “three types and two networks”, there are network security risks in every link of the power system, which is mainly reflected in the fact that the power information system has a large user base and large exposure, and at the same time stores a large amount of electricity customer data. bearing control business, once the system is breached, it will have a great impact on the society and economy. However, the network attack on power information system has the characteristics of “strong professionalism, deep latency, long persistence and great destructiveness”, so the security monitoring of power network and information system is faced with great challenges. Attackers generally use malicious programs to steal sensitive information, but with the progress of various intrusion detection technologies, malicious program anti-detection technology is also developing, which makes malicious program traffic very hidden and more difficult to be detected. Based on the shallow machine learning method, the ability to describe the characteristics of malicious programs is insufficient, and in the face of new malicious programs, such as inefficiency or failure, deep learning technology shows a strong learning ability in many application fields. this paper explores the research and application of malicious program traffic monitoring technology based on deep learning method. This paper studies the monitoring of abnormal traffic access behavior of malicious programs based on deep learning, and perceives abnormal traffic and security threats in real time.

articleTitle: Improvement Research on Harmonic DetectingBased on Instantaneous Reactive Power Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the power industry, more and more complex power electronic equipment operate in the power grid system, so that a large number of harmonics are injected into the power grid system. In order to quickly and accurately detect the harmonic current in the power grid, used the basic principle of harmonic detection algorithm based on instantaneous reactive power theory, a unit vector harmonic detection method based on basic instantaneous reactive power theory is proposed and simulated. The simulation results show that the improved harmonic current detection method proposed in this paper has good real-time performance and high detection accuracy, and has a good application prospect in engineering practice.

articleTitle: A research of digital forensic method based on the Checkm8 heap vulnerability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of mobile phones, mobile phone forensics is becoming increasingly important to the area of government activities. It is considerable difficult to conduct digital investigation work as the mobile phone manufacturer's user data is relatively well secured. In particular, forensic staff have difficulty in obtaining more information about the current situation when the phone holder refuses to give out the password. As the Checkm8 vulnerability requires physical access to the iPhone and the establishment of USB connections, this Apple chip vulnerability, which was revealed in 2019, is a technique that is more conducive to iPhone forensics. If paired with the libmobiledevice environment, forensics workers could gain high access to semi-encrypted data on some iPhone models through jailbreak while on the locked screen. Depending on the available decryption techniques, forensic workers can gain greater access to information about the phone's owner.

articleTitle: Link game recognition system based on image recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To realize the needs of players to complete Link games quickly and get high scores, a link game recognition system under the condition of real shooting is designed under the advantages of a computer's faster image processing speed than a human response. This paper mainly introduces the design process of the system based on the basic principle of template matching, analysis, and use of Hough transform, thinning, corner detection, path link, and other image processing methods, and finally the same can be eliminated two square images marked out. The practice shows that the system simplifies the operation, ensures accuracy, and improves recognition efficiency.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Corner Detection of LIDAR Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the current corner detection algorithm of LIDAR data is not accurate enough, an improved corner detection method of LIDAR data is proposed. Firstly, the LIDAR data is segmented into several point sets with breakpoints as boundaries to remove points with large errors and cluster points with continuity. Then, the Angle difference method is introduced on the basis of the line fitting step of the line tracking method, which is used to realize the optimization of the error detection of the line tracking method in the well-divided point sets. Finally, the method is verified in a real environment. Experimental results show that this method can detect corners well and improve the accuracy of corner detection effectively.

articleTitle: Prediction method in student relationship network based on Big Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In some universities, there will often be a Matthew effects problem of student groups, can scientifically explain this phenomenon, and make the best management prediction program, this is a hot problem of the school. By building a student group interaction's social network, the paper combines complex network characteristics with big data mining technology to establish prediction method to achieve predictions in the development trend of key nodes in the network. The prediction method mainly consists of two steps. The first is to use time series analysis to find groups with poor performance; it is used to explain the Matthew effects phenomenon in the social relationships network with uncertain. The second according to the first step's research, build predictive algorithms in complex networks, and give some suggestions in moral education and style education. The paper in theory puts forward a new prediction algorithm on the complex network, which provides targeted strategies for the management of college student education in application.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Target Recognition in Optical Remote Sensing Image Based on Local Feature Matching
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In modern naval warfare, ship target is an important combat force on the battlefield of naval warfare. Different types of ship target have differences in combat mode and combat positioning. In order to accurately grasp the enemy combat ship movement, accurately analyze the enemy combat intention and firepower coverage in the naval battle field, the accurate identification of the ship target becomes a key problem. In this paper, a ship target type recognition method based on SIFT feature and Harris corner feature matching is proposed in view of the close size and similar appearance of different types of ship targets.

articleTitle: Satellite Attitude Estimation based on an Improved Strong Tracking Particle Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Particle filter has been an efficient tool in many areas, how to improve the sampling efficiency of particle filter and the capability of an algorithm to track an abrupt change state is the key to the research and application of particle filter. This paper combines the strong tracking filter with the particle filter, and proposes the improved strong tracking particle filtering (ISTPF) algorithm. The algorithm uses strong tracking Kalman filter to generate a correction term and uses it to correct the sample particles during particle filtering, which greatly improves sampling efficiency and resolves the problem of particle degeneracy and low sampling efficiency in the traditional strong tracking particle filtering algorithms. Finally, the ISTPF algorithm and the other two strong tracking filters STUKF and STEPF are applied to the satellite attitude estimation which is described by multiplicative error quaternion under the same conditions, and the simulation results demonstrate that ISTPF has the highest precision, which indicating that the ISTPF is feasible and superior.

articleTitle: Research on Recommendation System Using Big Data Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: According to the recommendation algorithm based on deep learning, this article will verify the validity of the recommendation model through Item2vec and DeepFM models. To analyze the relationship between historical user behavior data and the users of the product are interested in, the Spark SQL scripts can be run according to statistical analysis methods, and generate the training set and test set, which is needed by train the model, and build predictive models, and get the collection of products that each user is interested in and improve the prediction effect through model optimization. Experimental verification and analysis show that the recommendation system can handle massive amounts of user and product data. It can also extract features from these data for training automatically, which is conducive to improving the quality and efficiency of users' shopping decisions. we first complete feature extraction based on the processed data set. At present, the most used feature extraction method is feature extraction based on artificial experience and statistical methods. However, because the actual application scenarios of the recommendation system are often more complicated, we used Spark SQL scripts to extract features in experiments. First, extract the experimental data from the distributed database, and use the workflow scheduling script to generate the data set required for model training and testing.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a 2.1-kV Charging Power Supply for Capacitor Array of Pulse Power Modulators
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For pulsed power systems, such as pulsed lasers and flash lamps, the pulse power modulator is required to offer high instantaneous power in a relatively short time. The required energy can be provided by fast charge and discharge energy storage capacitors. When charging the capacitor, rather than constant voltage mode, it is generally desirable to perform with constant current. This article is in view of a full-bridge-based series resonant constant current power supply, which includes topology research, model building, units design and relative experiments. The power supply has charged the 810µF capacitor array, consisting of sixteen capacitors, from 0-2100Vdc. The input is 380V/50Hz, and the output voltage is 2100Vdc. At the same time, it realizes soft switching, which improves efficiency and reduces switching loss.

articleTitle: Research on Test Information Management System for Aircraft Climatic Environment Test
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A test information management system is presented for aircraft climatic environment test in laboratory, which has the feature of complicated test procedure, long cycle and massive test information. By analyzing aircraft climatic environment test information management requirement, the function module of the system is gained. The hardware network topology is built based on the redundant industrial Ethernet, while the software architecture is designed based on the combination of B/S and C/S, finally the solution is expounded for fully management of the test project, test process, test resources, test data and database. The system achieves the goal of information management for aircraft climatic environment test in laboratory, and it improves the ability and the efficiency of aircraft climatic environment test.

articleTitle: Special Trade Concern Network Analysis Based on PageRank Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The TBT Committee provides members with a polygonal review of trade concerns. This paper builds a network based on the WTO Trade Concern Data Information Database providing data on special trade concerns, and calculates the PageRank value of each node in the network to find the key nodes. The study found that in the special trade attention network, the most influential countries are basically large trading countries, and developed countries and developing countries are more evenly distributed in the ranking of node importance.

articleTitle: Link Prediction in Multiplex Networks based on Topological and Latent Features
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Currently, most of link prediction models are designed for single-layer networks, while for complex net-work systems in the real world, there are many different relationships between network entities. Thus, it is more advis-able to use multi-layer networks to model real-world complex systems. In this paper, we design a multi-layer network link prediction model to predict the missing edges in the target layer. The model not only extracts features of the target layer but also mines features from other auxiliary layers to help improve the prediction performance. In addition, rich network information can be obtained by combining both topological features and also latent features. In order to get latent features, the model decomposes the adjacency matrix of the network by using matrix factorization based on stochastic gradient descent, and each node can obtain a vector representation accordingly. Finally, topological features and latent representation are used to train a binary classifier to predict the missing edges in the target layer. The results on five real-world multiplex networks show that our model outperforms the compared models in this paper.

articleTitle: A Technique of Pseudolite Cooperative Layout Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm in GNSS Ground Based Augmentation Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the cooperative positioning application of GNSS Ground Based Augmentation Systems (GBAS), the geometric layout scheme of pseudolite has great influence on the positioning accuracy. Aiming at this problem, a technique of cooperative layout based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm was proposed to obtain the best pseudolite location for the continuous trajectory coordinates of satellites in orbit, and the average GDOP corresponding to the positioning area was taken as the objective optimization function. PSO is used to update the pseudolite coordinates iteratively and make them move in the direction of decreasing average GDOP, so as to find the optimal pseudo-satellite coordinates. Through collecting relevant experimental data, calculating and analyzing them according to the technique, we find that the optimized pseudolite coordinates have good GDOP distribution in both the best and the worst case. The research result has important technical reference value for the application of high-precision cooperative positioning engineerings with GBAS.

articleTitle: SSD Based Target Detection Algorithm for the Autonomous Driving Vision System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Target detection algorithm takes a central role in autonomous driving vision system, participating in a wide rang of applications in the obstacle detection, vehicle detection, traffic state detection, and others. In recent years, accurate and efficient deep learning models have been proposed for real-time applications. However, the most accurate approaches tend to employ efficient feature fusion method and improved training strategy, such as spatial pyramid pooling. This practice limits real-time performance due to intense extra computational cost. In this paper, we avoid the traditional feature fusion method by proposing an efficient feature fusion method based on feature bi-directional fusion technique and introduce a training method with noise based on confidence loss sequence. We demonstrate the efficiency of the proposal on the PASCAL VOC2007 and KITTI sets, which include the common target detection task and typical autonomous driving target recognition task. The experimental results show that our approach significantly improve the accuracy for complex background samples and reduce the false detection rate of small targets by keeping real-time performance.

articleTitle: Multiphasic array radar target assignment algorithm based on improved Hopfield Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The problem of target allocation should be considered when the multi-target tracking is realized by multi-phased array radar. In this paper, an algorithm for target allocation of multi-phased array radar based on improved Hopfield neural network is proposed to improve the time utilization rate of radar and the possibility of tracking high-priority targets under the circumstance of time resource limitation. In this paper, a mathematical model of target allocation for multiphasic array radar is established, which takes the sum of time utilization and target priority as the objective function and radar time resource as the constraint condition. Secondly, the improved Hopfield neural network is introduced. This neural network alleviates the shortcoming of the common Hopfield neural network that is prone to fall into local optimal, and it is used for model solving. Finally, the simulation results show that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: The application of visual technology in the measurement of parts
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the efficiency problem of on-line shape and position tolerance quality inspection in industrial production, especially for the case that the surface to be tested is rigid plane, based on the relative fixed position of the camera and the part to be measured, the relationship between pixel and actual physical size is obtained by geometric optics principle on the basis of restraining lens distortion, and finally the machine vision is used The surface image information of the part to be measured is obtained by the sensing technology, and the key features are extracted to complete the calculation and analysis. The results show that the measurement period is 7.12ms, the measurement accuracy of part size is 0.1mm. The system has low requirements for hardware resources, and can be deployed online to realize full inspection of parts. The comprehensive performance is better than the current contact parts measurement. It can be seen that this method can realize on-line shape and position tolerance detection of parts, and has a great help to improve the quality of parts production.

articleTitle: Design of Monitoring System Based on Event Camera
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To solve the problems of motion blurring and the small dynamic range of the optical monitoring system, this paper proposes a new type of intelligent monitoring system based on a new sensor-event camera. The system firstly preprocesses and visualizes the data collected by the event camera; secondly, it extracts the two-way directional gradient histogram feature of the event image, and then maximizes the classification of the positive and negative samples through the support vector machine to obtain feature detectors; Finally, it detects the reconstructed image of the event camera and automatically recognizes the target. The experimental results show that the method of using directional gradient histogram features combined with classifiers can obtain a higher detection rate for event camera image recognition. The system has low power consumption and can work in a larger illumination range without being affected by target movement, and has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Design and Research on the Pressure Shell of Submarine Seismograph
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Referring to the design methods and criteria of external pressure vessel and flange connection, the structure, connection and sealing mode of a pressure shell of seabed seismograph are designed, the structural form, design size and materials of the pressure shell are reasonably determined, and the reliability of the pressure shell design is verified through theoretical calculation. Then, the computer-aided design software Ansys Workbench is used to analyze the strength of the pressure shell, and at the same time, the sealing performance of the bolt flange connection and the force of the bolt are studied. The pressure-resistant shell works on the seabed at a depth of 200 meters. The theoretical calculation and simulation analysis results have verified the feasibility of the design scheme, which can provide a certain reference for the design of the non-standard external pressure shell structure and connection and sealing methods.

articleTitle: Research on hierarchical Linkage threat response Model of Power Information Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Nowadays,a lot of work has been done on network security protection. Only by fully identifying security risks can effective security measures be taken. However, a large number of continuous operation of security protection equipment produces a huge amount of alarm, which makes it difficult for security administrators to understand the security threat status of the system in the face of a large number of alarm information, and can not take appropriate response measures in a timely manner. can not integrate multi-dimensional security information, linkage of multi-type security equipment for threat defense means and measures. Therefore, by studying the threat response mechanism, this paper establishes a hierarchical linkage defense threat response model, and puts forward an intelligent decision-making method of linkage strategy on the basis of the threat response model to optimize the security policy.

articleTitle: Construction of Domain-specific Knowledge Graph of Forest Diseases based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to effectively organize and manage the text knowledge of forest diseases, this paper proposes a knowledge graph construction method based on deep learning, which uses the knowledge graph to describe the complex relationship between entities in a structured form. Firstly, the general method of constructing forest disease knowledge graph is described. Secondly, the characteristics of forest disease text are analyzed, preprocessed and labeled. And the data set is constructed. Then, for the unstructured text in the data set, the innovative deep learning method of Bi-gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) and Conditional Random Field(CRF) model is used to identify the named entities of forest disease names and therapeutic agents. Experiments on forest disease attribute text corpus show that the precison is 93.15%, which can be effectively applied to the named entity recognition task of forest disease text. Finally, the extracted knowledge is stored in the neo4j map database to intuitively reflect the internal structure of the knowledge graph and realize the visualization and reasoning based on forest disease knowledge.

articleTitle: Research on Taylor Weight Optimization Algorithm Based on Circular Conformal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the work of most existing conformal array beamforming optimization algorithms, the traditional Taylor optimization algorithm of linear array is usually adopted, which results in that the antenna performance can not reach optimal level. In another case, a conformal array optimization algorithm which only considering horizontal factors increases the sidelobe level (SLL) and decreases the mainlobe gain. In view of the wide application of conformal arrays, this letter illustrates a Taylor optimization algorithm based on circular conformal array. Firstly, the circular conformal array can be divided into subarrays according to its geometric characteristics. Secondly, project the elements in the mapped molecular region, obtain the coordinate matrix of non-uniform distribution in the horizontal direction, then normalize the corresponding current excitation ratio in the vertical direction. Thirdly, combining these two factors, Taylor weighting coefficient suitable for circular conformal array is obtained. Finally, the simulation performance under different sidelobe level values is observed.

articleTitle: Online Consumer Identification Method for Live Streaming Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper studies the key technology of ID card recognition for online consumer identification method, which involves image processing, pattern recognition, neural network, and other fields, and based on the key technology of the system software programming, testing and demonstrating the results of identification. The processing and identification method used in this paper is relatively simple, easy to implement, and has a good identification effect, provides an effective id card automatic identification system scheme. The method proposed in this paper can be used for the fast identification of consumers on live broadcast platforms, for subsequent recommendation classification tasks, and intelligent recommendation algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Early Warning Model of Enterprise Financial Crisis Based on Structural Fuzzy Twin Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The emergence of financial crisis will bring great losses to investors and related stakeholders. Therefore, it is of great significance to establish an effective financial crisis early warning model and prevent the financial risks that enterprises may appear. Aiming at the problems of unbalanced sample set data, abnormal point interference and the inability to consider sample structure information in financial crisis early warning, this paper selects 29 explanatory variables to establish financial early warning index system based on financial indicators and non-financial indicators. Then, a financial crisis early warning model based on structure fuzzy twin support vector machine is constructed, Finally, the model is proved by using the data of A-share listed enterprises. The results show that the model is superior to the existing logistic and support vector machine models in the aspects of early warning accuracy, anti-interference, robustness and generalization, and has great application value.

Author Keywords: Structural fuzzy twin support vector machine

articleTitle: A data-driven optimization model for e-commerce based on hybrid ALNS-PSO algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to gain a competitive advantage among emerging peers, e-commerce companies must not only design new products favored by consumers, but also consider product supply chain services to achieve better business results. This paper develops a data-driven optimization model based on logistic regression and multi-objective programming to provide a practical low-cost solution for e-commerce supply chain optimization. As decision maker, e-retailers, the key to decision-making lies in choosing a supplier with a suitable geographical location and low production cost from a large number of homogeneous suppliers. This paper analyzes consumer transaction data, obtains the correlation between various types of products and geographic districts, and matches suitable suppliers for different regions to reduce costs. Combining adaptive large neighborhood search (ALNS) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm, a hybrid ALNS-PSO is designed to solve the proposed data-driven model. A practical case proved the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Estimation of Centroid Position of Silicon Particles Based on GAN and Visual Tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, we used generative adversarial network (GAN) and visual tracking to detect the growth of silicon particles. To solve the problem of fewer data sets, we use the Wasserstein-GAN (WGAN) model to expand the data set. From the loss functions of the generator and discriminator, the quality of the data generated by the model is high. The position of the center of mass of the silica particles during the melting process was determined by the extracted tracking mark results, and the motion trajectory of the center of mass of the silica was given.

articleTitle: Design of a Portable Multi-parameter Tester for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the life safety of coal mine workers, a portable multi-parameter tester with Internet of Things function was developed. Using 16-bit ultra-low power consumption microcontroller chip as the control core, combined with electrochemical carbon monoxide/hydrogen sulfide two-in-one sensing element, electrochemical oxygen sensing element, infrared methane/carbon dioxide two-in-one sensing element for five-parameter sensor design, real-time monitoring and early warning of hazardous gas information in the surrounding environment of downhole operators. Through the use of two-in-one probes, the instrument is miniaturized, gas measurement types are diversified, and highly integrated. Combined with multi-axis acceleration sensors to monitor the movement of miners. Using Bluetooth 5.0 BLEMESH to realize the self-organizing network function of the Internet of Things, combined with the underground Bluetooth-enabled monitoring, positioning or life safety monitoring base station, the personal and surrounding environmental information and personnel movement information can be uploaded to the well to realize the monitoring and protection of the personal life safety of personnel, and make up for the lack of personal protective equipment for miners.

articleTitle: Establishment of Knowledge Service Platform based on Big Data Resource
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The influence of big data on the university library is studied with the focus on how scientific researchers are confused by the massive digital resources of the university library in their data collection. Considering the current development of digital resources, the integrated method of” self-development + outsourcing “could be employed to help maximize the value of knowledge by virtue of knowledge sharing and knowledge innovation. The key technology of big data management system is applied in the unified planning, integrated processing and mining analysis of big data resources, so as to gradually establish the knowledge service platform based on the big data resources. The establishment and application of the knowledge service platform could effectively facilitate the sharing of the big data resources and the collaborative and innovative development of scientific research.

articleTitle: Discussion of Circuits in Intelligent Cups
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: intelligent cups had been chosen as our favorite portable cups in our bags for a long time. Not only their smart volume, but also their multiple abilities were useful to everyone. In this paper, several circuits were discussed according to their different functions. Some circuits were used as signal amplification functions. Some ones were used as transmission of electromagnetic wave signals. Some ones were use as fingerprint identification. These functions were components of the whole circuits. In these components, energy absorption parts were important ones. According to different functions of varied circuits, some improvements could be done with different requirements. Certainly, 51 single chips were usually important in the whole circuits.

articleTitle: Implementation and scheme of IPv4 to IPv6 Transition in enterprise network architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, IPv6 faces the problem of compatibility with IPv4 in large-scale applications. The transition technologies between IPv6 and IPv4 can be divided into three kinds: dual protocol stack technology, tunnel technology encapsulated by IP data gram and transparent conversion technology. Based on the research on the transition technology of IPv4 and IPv6, taking the enterprise network application as the object, through the experimental simulation implementation mode, compare the relevant configuration schemes, simulate the protocol transition technology in the scheme construction, allocate IPv6 addresses on the line, discuss the security technology of IPv6, and realize the transition of IPv4 and IPv6 under the enterprise network architecture.

articleTitle: Dynamic Time Slot Allocation Scheme of Space Vehicle Ad Hoc Network Based on Dual Frequency Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For solving the problem that traditional TDMA time slot allocation method using in space vehicle Ad Hoc network have a large network delay and low efficiency, a Dual Frequency Dynamic Time Division Multiple Access (DF-DTDMA) is proposed. A nested time slot allocation strategy was proposed to reduce collaborative interaction information delay, and time slots were dynamically allocated based on location information to achieve space reuse and reduce end-to-end delay of services. The simulation results show that compared with the TDMA protocol, the proposed time-slot allocation scheme DF-DTDMA can effectively reduce the network delay and packet loss rate,and improve the network throughput.

articleTitle: Modulated Signal Recognition based on Feature-multiplexed Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Modulated signal identification plays a crucial role in both military reconnaissance and civilian signal regulation. Traditionally, modulated signal identification is based on high-order statistics, but this approach has many drawbacks. With the development of deep learning, its advantages are fully exploited by combining it with modulated signals to avoid the complex process of computing a priori knowledge while having good fault tolerance. In this paper, ten digital modulated signals are classified and recognized, and improvements are made on the basis of convolutional neural networks, using feature reuse to increase the depth of the convolutional layer and extract signal features with better results. After experimental analysis, the recognition accuracy increases with the rise of the signal-to-noise ratio, and can reach 90% and above when the signal-to-noise ratio is 30dB.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Remote Sensing Process Language based on XML
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the era of rapid development of remote sensing technology, in order to improve the production efficiency of remote sensing data processing flow and further optimize the editing of remote sensing processes in the visual interface. In this paper we have analyzed the characteristics and attributes of remote sensing processes and algorithms. We made the production of processes and algorithms into scripts, and realizes to create remote sensing processes by inputting scripting language in the visual interface. A remote sensing language based on XML is designed to read and store key information. This language will use XML to drive the production of remote sensing process. With the language we design, a remote sensing process customization system has been implemented. It can improve the editing and production efficiency of remote sensing data processing flow.

articleTitle: Research on 5G Signal Positioning Technology of Amur Tiger Locator for Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper studies a 5G signal wireless location method for Amur Tiger portable locator. The Amur Tiger locator sends 5G signals, which are connected to the signal reception and detection system in the Amur Tiger Park. The real-time monitoring of the position and movement of the Amur tiger through the big data platform is beneficial for researchers and keepers to study the population movement rules and living habits of the Amur tiger. This paper proposes the method of location fingerprint analysis. In the online stage, the possible location of the Amur Tiger is matched with the fingerprint data in the location fingerprint database by using the mobile terminal device, and then the most reasonable matching result is obtained to estimate the location of the Amur Tiger. Finally, we applied the weighted K-nearest neighbor method to the 5G signal locator and obtained a small error.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of power grid operation environment simulation system based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid and profound changes in all aspects of power system, the control scale increases exponentially, the characteristics of control objects vary greatly, the bilateral uncertainty of source load increases, and the power grid real-time dispatching will be more complex and frequent. In this paper, we combine current advanced artificial intelligence technology and power grid dispatching business needs, design and develop power grid operation environment simulation system based on reinforcement learning. The system determines the power grid scenario according to the user's choice, applies the real-time power grid operation data, directly interacts with the decision agent, realizes the agent's autonomous learning and continuously improves its regulation and decision-making ability. The system has good feasibility, practicability and scalability, realizes the standardization of workflow, and provides an effective decision support tool for power grid dispatching.

articleTitle: Research on Orbit Design Method for On-orbit Service of High Orbit Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper studies the relative motion modeling and mission planning methods of high-orbit spacecraft for on-orbit services. Based on the C-W equation, the single-pulse spiral cruise trajectory, single-pulse circumnavigation trajectory, and single-pulse circumnavigation trajectory are constructed. Considering that the single-pulse flight period is too long, the design methods of the multi-pulse ramp approach and multi-pulse circumnavigation are further studied. Secondly, considering the constraints of lighting conditions, obstacle constraints, specific path constraints, only angle measurement, and target continuous maneuvering, the approach to target maneuver planning is studied. Finally, the validity of the planning model and algorithm is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A Concurrent Message Processing Mechanism for Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the intelligent networked automobile industry, the current OBU (on-board-unit) and RSU (roadside-unit) have been installed on high-performance multi-core chips. The latest related technologies can already support 5th Generation (5G) communication. Therefore, how the upper-level application should adapt to the exponential growth trend of data volume has become an urgent problem in the industry. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a multi-thread synchronization mechanism based on atomic operands and a blocking scheme based on condition variables. In the producer-consumer model, the message production process is optimized for the five types of messages in the Internet of Vehicles, and a more lightweight message queue with higher resource utilization is provided to users. Various parameters involved in this method have been tested in multiple scenarios. The experimental results show that in non-extreme scenarios, this method can maintain a good performance and smoothly complete the work of message production, consumption and analysis. A flexible configuration interface for users also provided to quickly adapt to different device platforms, ensuring the flexibility of functional software.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis of Aircraft Electrical Power Supply System Using Intelligent Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The aircraft electrical power supply system is an important and complex system. Once it breaks down and will lead to power failure in the air, which will bring serious consequences. If the fault diagnosis of this system is carried out manually, it depends heavily on the work experience and technical level of maintenance personnel, which leads to the slow and inaccurate. The intelligent processing technology has advantage of fast calculation and large-capacity information storage by using high-speed micro-processor, it is ideal to complete on-line or off-line fault diagnosis of aircraft electrical power supply system. In this paper, the fault diagnosis analysis and logic judgment of aircraft electrical power supply system is carried out by using intelligent processing technology; the fault can be found and located in time by using fault diagnosis model and system state database, to improve the reliability and maintainability of aircraft electrical power supply system.

articleTitle: A New Time Series Outlier Pattern Detection Approach based on Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Time series pattern outlier represents a pattern with abnormal behavior that is significantly different from other patterns in the time series and can induce a bias in the decision-making process related to design, operation, and management. This research focuses on the problem of detecting anomalous patterns from time series data. The main consideration is the fact that normal pattern can be modeled by some statistical models and anomalous patterns cannot. Combined with characteristics of time series data, this research develops an effective and accurate outlier pattern detection approach SAX_ePST to detect anomalous patterns in time series. Experiments indicate the proposed methods are fast and correctly identifying anomalous pattern.

articleTitle: Application of QPSO Algorithm in Aeroengine Performance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A new and practical solution, Quantum-behaved Particle Swam Optimization (QPSO) algorithm, is applied to aeroengine performance optimization implemented for some turbo fan engine. Simulation is carried out under different altitudes and velocities and shows that thrust can be increased by 7%~9% under maximum thrust mode, 0.3%~3.7% more than that by Particle Swam Optimization (PSO) algorithm while fuel consumption can be decreased by 2%~3% under the minimum fuel consumption mode. The influence of initial values on PSO algorithm is reduced and the problem of being easily trapped in local optimal values is solved as well. Apparently, the algorithm is of great application value.

Author Keywords: Turbo fan engine. Performance optimization. Quantum-behaved Particle Swam Optimization algorithm. Particle Swam Optimization algorithm

articleTitle: A Novel Binary Immune Elite Evolutionary Algorithm to Improve The Revenues of Spectrum Allocation In Medical Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Medical cognitive radio network (MCRN) is a communication technology applied to cognitive electronic medical systems in recent years, and its spectrum is an important scarce resource. There is a phenomenon of low utilization between the rapidly growing demand for wireless spectrum resources and the existing spectrum allocation strategy. In view of the limited spectrum resources of MCRN, this paper proposes a novel binary immune elite evolutionary algorithm (BIEEA) to solve the problem of spectrum allocation. The algorithm uses binary encoding, and designs immune strategies and elite strategies to enhance the optimization capabilities of the algorithm. Under the same experimental conditions, BIEEA is compared with genetic algorithm (GA) and artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm respectively. The simulation results show that the performance and convergence speed of the BIEEA are superior to the other two algorithms. In addition, BIQEA has high network revenue, which can improve the utilization of spectrum resources and effectively alleviate the shortage of spectrum resources, thereby improving the communication quality of the cognitive electronic medical system.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of service call method across security zone in new generation dispatch control system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the new generation dispatching automation system, production control area and non production control area adopt forward and backward isolation devices for physical isolation, with the increase of business data and application function relevance between the security regions and the expansion of the system functions, the traditional way of data interaction based on E file with isolation device can not meet the requirements of existing business efficiency.In accordance with the principles of safety protection standards, It is urgent to establish a high-speed data transmission mechanism that can cross the forward and reverse isolation to achieve efficient and real-time service invocation across the security zone. In this paper, an efficient service invocation scheme across security zones is proposed, which can be invoked by the service bus that can be transparent and unaware service bus, encapsulate cross domain service protocol, establish virtual access, and complete service invocation. Through the signature verification technology, the service message is tampered in the communication, the communication security of the service call is guaranteed, the rights of the service are obtained through the authorization and the security of the service call cross the security region

articleTitle: Iterative Fourier Algorithm and Application Based on Comprehensive Testing Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
