abstract: An iterative fast Fourier transform (IFFT) algorithm based on Comprehensive test method (CTM) is proposed and applied to the low sidelobe optimization of the end-fire array antenna pattern. First, for the mutual coupling problem in the end-fire array, a comprehensive test method is used to obtain the coupling compensation matrix, and the coupling compensation matrix is incorporated into the IFFT algorithm, so that the algorithm considering the mutual coupling effect meets the principle of far-field pattern multiplication again. Secondly, design an end-fire antenna unit structure, based on this unit to form a 64-element end-fire phased array, simulation and comparison of genetic algorithm and CTM-IFFT algorithm to optimize the effect of low side lobes of the pattern. The simulation results show that in the scanning range of 0° to 90°, the array pattern can achieve low sidelobe effect after optimization by CTM-IFFT algorithm, and it takes less time than the genetic optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Intelligent Protection Strategy of distribution network based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the context of building a new power system with new energy as the main part, the operation mode of distribution network is more complex, and the traditional distribution network protection strategy can hardly meet the demand, so this paper proposes a distributed intelligent protection strategy for distribution network based on reinforcement learning. This paper analyzes the impact of new energy resources access on distribution network relay protection, and presents an intelligent protection algorithm model based on deep reinforcement learning. The structure of intelligent protection device is designed, and the distribution network distributed protection scheme based on intelligent protection device is proposed. Finally, the algorithm training process is given, and the experimental environment is built.

articleTitle: Laser-Acoustic-Combination Evaluation System For Historical Frescos Damage Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to propose a laser-acoustic-combination evaluation system for historical frescos damage detection. This article outlines a diagnostic test system and procedure with laser-acoustic combined method, advantage of which is remote and cause no damage to the artwork, and that is based on the frequency response analysis of the acoustic excitation of the wall vibration with laser vibrometer sensing. The detail of the test procedure for wall vibration and the system of the measurement instrument is described. Experiments were performed on a real artificial fresco in a historic curved vault. A two-dimensional map of curved surface vibration amplitudes is generated by measuring points by points on the surface. This false-color image is then processed through image analysis techniques to determine the location and shape of the damaged area.

articleTitle: Implementation of DMA driver development under Linux
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The emergence of Direct Memory Access (DMA) aims to solve the problems of traditional central processing unit (CPU) processing transaction data width, transmission data bit limit, low transmission speed and so on. Using Xilinx Zynq-7000 in Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) to provide DMA soft core for data transmission cannot meet the specific application requirements of communication with the host computer. Because its Linux system has all the advantages of files, open source code, support for cross-platform hardware, and strong portability, the Linux system that transplants DMA driver on Zynq PS side can meet the specific requirements of communication with the host computer. And the DMA driver designed in this article serves as a bridge between Advanced RISC Machines (ARM) and FPGA to support any 4.x version of Xilinx kernel and any board using Zynq-7000 series processing system.

articleTitle: A New Model of the Public Sentiment Index based on Social Degree of Separation Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the data mining and deep learning developing, more and more data sources are taking into account in the algorithm to get more accurate result. But it is not true that the model with the most data sources is the best one.In this paper, the Cross-Four Degrees Data analysis Model(CFDDM) is proposed to analysis public sentiment index, which is in a new view and combined with social science theory. The theory of the social degree of separation and social attribution are taken into account to analysis. In this paper, the CFDDM use the four degrees of separation theory to analysis the public sentiment, not use the six degrees of separation theory, because the patterns of the information exchange have changed largely than ever,because the developing of internet and new techniques. The four data sources from four different fields are used to analysis the public sentiment index. The weights of different data sources are computed dynamically through probability. The experiment demonstrates that the model is more reasonable and accurate than the models using only one data source.

articleTitle: An Improved Average Value Model for Simulating the Blocking State of HVDC-Flexible Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the average model can be used to simulate the external electrical characteristics of HVDC-flexible transmission system, the computational complexity does not change with the number of sub modules. However, the existing average model can not reflect the blocking characteristics of converter, so that the starting process and DC fault process can not be accurately simulated. A improved average model of HVDC-flexible transmission system is proposed, which can effectively simulate the relevant waveform after converter locking. The tests show that the proposed improved average model can make up for the shortcomings of the existing average model in simulating converter lockout and DC fault, and improve its effectiveness in simulating the operating conditions of HVDC-flexible transmission system.

articleTitle: The Vital Signs Monitoring System of The Elderly Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the aging of the population becoming more and more serious, the safety problem of the elderly has become increasingly prominent. In order to better protect the life safety of the elderly, a set of portable and wearable mobile terminal is designed for monitoring the elderly's vital signs, with STM32 as the main controller, and related sensors being used to collect the elderly's parameters such as the blood pressure, oxygen saturation and CEG, etc., as well as the precise positioning of the elderly, ensuring that the elderly receive timely assistance if they fall down. This system would build a cloud platform to visualize the vital sign data of the elderly, which is convenient for managers to adapt afterwards. After experimental verification, this system is proved to be effective on monitoring the vital signs of the elderly, being aware of the poor state of the elderly, and notifying the relevant rescuers in time.

articleTitle: On the Optimal Selection of Measured Data in Time Domain for Structural Identification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The results of structural identifications rely generally on the data measured in time domain. Reasonable results of structural identification can only be obtained on the basis of the measured data with sufficient information. This paper aimed to deal with the optimal selection of measured data for structural identification. The Fisher information matrix (FIM) of measured data in time domain was derived by the likelihood function that was obtained with the probability density function of these data. And the trace of FIM might be effective in selecting the most informative among the available measured data as the optimal one for structural identification. In order to implement the calculation of FIM, the formulae of calculating the partial derivatives of calculated data by using the corresponding mathematical model with respect to identification parameters, were developed. With the studied case of one multi-degree-of-freedom spring-mass system, the identification results, based on different simulated measured data while on the other identical conditions for calculations, were compared. The results of comparison showed that, among them, the one corresponding to the most informative data selected by using the proposed method was the most reasonable, which demonstrated the validity of the method.

articleTitle: An expressive ciphertext-policy attribute-based encryption with outsourced decryption in blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Ciphertext-Policy Attribute-Based Encryption (CP-ABE) allows data to be encrypted under an access policy, which is specified as a logical combination of attributes. However, CP-ABE schemes usually use expensive operations (i.e. modular exponentiations and bilinear pairings) to generate long ciphertexts and secret key, which makes them difficult to implement in practical applications, especially for resource constrained devices. Fortunately, with the development of cloud computing and blockchain technology, users can outsource most of the decryption costs to proxy, while the underlying plaintext is still confidential. In this scheme, we proposed an expressive ciphertext-policy attributebased encryption with outsourced decryption in blockchain. Suppose that ABE ciphertexts are stored in the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS), the user can provide the proxy with a single transformation key that allows he/she to translate any ABE ciphertext satisfied by that users attributes into a few ciphertexts which can support user to verify and the a summarized ElGamalstyle ciphertext. The scheme is selectively RCCA-secure in the random oracle model for large message spaces.

articleTitle: Research on Security Defense System of Industrial Control Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The importance of the security of industrial control network has become increasingly prominent. Aiming at the defects of main security protection system in the intelligent manufacturing industrial control network, we propose a security attack risk detection and defense, and emergency processing capability synchronization technology system suitable for the intelligent manufacturing industrial control system. Integrating system control and network security theories, a flexible and reconfigurable system-wide security architecture method is proposed. On the basis of considering the high availability and strong real-time of the system, our research centers on key technologies supporting system-wide security analysis, defense strategy deployment and synchronization, including weak supervision system reinforcement and pattern matching, etc.. Our research is helpful to solve the problem of industrial control network of “old but full of loopholes” caused by the long-term closed development of the production network of important parts, and alleviate the contradiction between the high availability of the production system and the relatively backward security defense measures.

articleTitle: Research on Sbstation Method based on Intelligent Evaluation Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, deep learning, data mining and other technologies are widely used in practical work such as text analysis and image processing, which makes the holographic whole process intelligent evaluation of substation operation technically feasible. This paper intends to apply the above advanced technologies to the automatic analysis of operation tickets, personnel safety, intelligent management of tools and instruments and personnel real-time positioning technology, so as to realize the identification and evaluation of personnel behavior. In order to judge and score the personnel's operation tasks, the standard process of the operation should be monitored, recorded and compared through multiple dimensions such as personnel operation code of conduct, equipment operation accuracy, cross-border operation, use of tools and instruments, on-site recovery after operation and so on.

articleTitle: Research on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion method based on cross-modal transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: There are a large number of heterogeneous data in manufacturing industry, which are characterized by diversity of sources, low quality and complex types, and there are also some problems such as poor data consistency, weak availability and low sharing rate. Therefore, a multi-source heterogeneous information fusion method based on Transformer is proposed in this paper. The method can fuse multi-source heterogeneous data of multiple modes of enterprises, and make use of complementary information of cross-modal heterogeneous data to form the combination and unified expression of data features. The method focuses on the interaction between multi-mode sequences across different time steps and completes the fusion from one mode to another. The empirical analysis shows that the proposed multi-mode fusion method can well fuse different types of heterogeneous data, and a good fusion data set can effectively improve the model classification effect and provide data support for subsequent data analysis and decision-making.

articleTitle: Multi-domain battlefield threat assessment based on D-S evidence theory and conditional probability table
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the scope of battlefield is more and more extensive, and multi-domain Defensive operations are getting more and more attention. In order to improve the accuracy of multi-domain battlefield threat assessment, so as to deploy troops scientifically for effective defense, the probabilities of attacks occurring in each regional battlefield are calculated by D-S evidence theory, and then the probabilities of attacks succeeding are calculated by using conditional probability table when attacks are occurring in corresponding area. The probabilities of attacks succeeding are used to assess regional battlefield threat. On the basis of regional battlefield threat, the entire battlefield threat is calculated by combining regional weight. Finally, the results of case show that the proposed method is in line with the actual situation and the assessment results are accurate and effective.

articleTitle: Node classification without features using graph convolutional network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Graph convolutional network (GCN) is proposed to deal with graph-structured data, and is applied to many fields successfully, such as computer vision, natural language processing and biology. Most current graph convolutional networks and its derivative methods need node features for classification. In fact, it is a formidable task to obtain node feature or other information. Therefore, we mainly focus on improving accuracy of GCN on the graphs with node features. In order to resolve the issue, we propose a local shortest path GCN (LpGCN) in this work. The proposed method only regard q-hop shortest path distance as node feature, and then employ GCN to realize node classification. The experiment results show that the proposed method can significantly improve the accuracy of node classification in the networks without node features.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Energy Management Strategy for Split CHEV Based on Low SOC Condition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the typical Split CHEV on the market has the problem of poor equivalent fuel economy performance under the conditions of low SOC and high power demand. In response to this problem, an energy management strategy based on maximum comprehensive energy utilization efficiency of CHEV under low SOC state (referred to as optimized energy management strategy) is proposed. In series mode, the battery power is used as the optimized variable, and the maximum comprehensive energy utilization efficiency is used as the objective function to optimize. In parallel mode, the engine torque is used as the optimized variable, and the maximum comprehensive energy utilization efficiency is the objective function to optimize. In this way, the equivalent fuel consumption of CHEV per 100 kilometers is reduced.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Speech Electronic Whiplash
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on the large market demand of teachers and students for electronic teaching whip, a teaching whip that can integrate voice transmission system and control computer PPT playback, page up and down, laser indication and other functions is designed. According to these functional requirements, it is necessary to realize the propagation and restoration of speech function through speech control and modulation and demodulation, and the conversion, modulation and demodulation of data signals to control the PPT page turning function of PC. The main control chip involved mainly includes AD conversion and analog keyboard chip. The main control chip includes STM32, STC15 series single chip microcomputer, DSP for speech signal processing, standing microphone for speech sampling, power amplifier circuit reduction amplification. The DA handles and simulates the key value of the keyboard. Finally, the function of speech transmission amplification and control of PPT page and laser indication is realized.

articleTitle: A New Cross Detection Method for Triangular Patches
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The traditional collision detection of triangular patches is mostly attributed to the position relationship between line segments and points in triangular patches. To judge the position relationship between the three edges and three vertices of triangular patches, it is necessary to calculate the spatial position relationship for many times. The separation, intersection and parallel relationship between spatial triangular patches should be discussed in many cases, which is very complex. While the intersection judgment of triangles on the two-dimensional plane is much simpler. In view of this, this paper proposes a new collision detection method that transforms two spatial triangular patches into the same plane triangular patch. The complexity of triangle collision detection is effectively reduced and the efficiency of collision detection is improved.

articleTitle: A Radar Azimuth DOA Estimation Method Based on Gaussian Fitting of Antenna Pattern
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: There is only one signal receiving channel in azimuth mechanical scanning radar, which makes it difficult to estimate DOA. The maximum signal method and the minimum mean square error estimation method are usually be used to estimate the azimuth DOA of mechanical scanning radar. However, the two methods do not use the known radar antenna pattern information in calculation, resulting in poor estimation accuracy. To solve this problem, a Gaussian function least square fitting method based on radar azimuth antenna pattern fitting is proposed in this paper. The method makes use of the known radar antenna pattern information to improve the accuracy of azimuth angle measurement. Since matrix operation is involved in the process of solving the parameters of the Gaussian function, the computation is heavy and time-consuming. In order to improve the real-time performance, this paper deduces the formula of the parameter operation of the Gaussian function according to the known parameters, and obtains the fast solving formula of the center of the Gaussian function. The experimental results show that the angle measurement method based on Gaussian fitting of antenna pattern has better angle measurement accuracy under different signal-to-noise ratios and when the sampling point deviates from the center of the beam. In addition, the calculation time of this method does not increase significantly, and it is easy to be implemented in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Radar Autonomous Recognition Technology of Sea Target
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, radar technology and the increasingly demand for unmanned combat, the research on radar target autonomous recognition (RATR) has been developing continuously. This paper summarizes the key problems and research status in the field of radar recognition of sea target, summarizes the research progress of various common RATR methods, and puts forward three RATR schemes based on multi information radar recognition result fusion, reliable pseudo label and transfer learning, so as to solve the problem of few training samples in the process of radar autonomous recognition of sea target. Carry out the simulation verification of radar target recognition based on transfer learning, and the simulation results show that the recognition accuracy can reach 97%. It can be concluded that using transfer learning can effectively overcome the problem of small number of samples and improve the accuracy of marine target radar recognition.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Wireless Communication Receiving System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Using Multisim software to visually simulate and analyze the wireless communication receiving system, it mainly builds a complete system of AM wave receiving and demodulation. Through the parameter setting in the unit circuit, it is ensured that the weak AM wave signal can be further amplified, received, processed and demodulated. Through simulation, deepen the understanding of the basic principles of the unit circuit, and use different simulation tools to compare and analyze the index points of the high-frequency small-signal amplifier circuit, the local oscillator, the mixer circuit, the detector circuit, and the low-frequency power amplifier circuit, in order to build the receiving system Provides concrete and feasible ideas.

articleTitle: Research on firmware vulnerability mining technology of power industrial control terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As the terminal of power system, power terminal plays important functions such as perception, instruction execution, user interaction and so on. Compared with the centrally deployed background application system, the power terminal is closer to the user side and faces a more complex physical environment. At the same time, due to the limitations of the physical configuration of the terminal, its own security protection capability is weaker than that of the server. Therefore, this paper makes an in-depth research on the security risk detection technology of power terminal, and puts forward the method of security detection of power terminal-industrial control terminal.A security depth detection method for power terminal is proposed. Aiming at the firmware of power industrial control terminal, through the feature analysis and extraction of binary program vulnerabilities, the efficient vulnerability mining method and automatic execution technology are studied, and an efficient scheduling algorithm of firmware vulnerability mining based on decision tree is proposed. an efficient and accurate ability to mine vulnerabilities in binary programs is established, which reduces the hidden dangers of vulnerabilities in power network assets.

articleTitle: Educational visualization application based on machine learning algorithm to predict student learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of computer applications, machine learning has become more widely used in the field of education, machine learning can analyze the learning situation of a large number of students more efficiently, and timely understand the learning effectiveness of students and assist in improving learning efficiency. This paper first uses a variety of machine learning models to analyze the relevant factors of student learning, extract the potential relevance of various factors in student learning, and then promote the development of student learning in a positive direction. Then, based on Logistic Regression(LR), Support Vector Classification(SVC), Decision Tree(DT), eXtreme Gradient Boosting(XBG) and Random Forest(RF) predict student learning. Finally, based on the comparison of prediction performance, the prediction performance of random forest algorithm on abnormal data and its reasons are further analyzed. It is clear that educational visualization application based on machine learning algorithm can better provide choices for students' learning and development. And it can get students' learning feedback efficiently, and then improve the quality of education.

articleTitle: VS + OpenCV based binocular vision for A4 paper length measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Binocular vision ranging is becoming more and more widely used. In this paper, based on the principle of binocular camera ranging, a binocular ranging system is built with the help of Win10+VS2017+0penCV3.4.6. The calibration of the binocular camera is completed using the Zhang Zhengyou chessboard calibration method and Matlab2017b calibration toolbox. On the basis of BM matched ranging, the method of Canny edge detection, Sobel edge detection and Scharr filter edge detection edge detection followed by BM matched ranging was proposed to obtain the 3D information of the target point on the parallax map, and the difference of the effective target point to the x coordinate was the length of the measured paper. The experimental results demonstrate that the canny edge detection followed by BM matching distance measurement method yields more accurate results with a smaller error of 1.6% or less.

articleTitle: An adaptive 5G edge computing center deployment method for power terminal coverage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to promote the realization of the goal of “the new power system boosting the dual-carbon strategy”, it is required to accelerate the deep integration of 5G and the power system. The application of 5G edge computing centers in the power field requires to meet the requirements of low latency, large bandwidth, and efficient processing. This paper proposes an adaptive deployment method for power 5G edge computing centers based on the improved D-K-means clustering algorithm. This method is based on the D-K-means clustering algorithm and combines factors such as density, distance and coverage. It can adaptively determine the optimal deployment scale and the optimal deployment address of the 5G edge computing center in the power. It is verified that compared with the K-means and D-K-means algorithms, the improved algorithm has the advantages of wide coverage, definite deployment scale, and stable deployment location.

articleTitle: Backstepping Terminal Sliding Mode Control for Surface Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: There are often friction or even mechanical transmission clearance in the position tracking system of surface permanent magnet synchronous motor, which restricts the performance increase of the motor control system. When the system is subjected to internal parameter perturbation or load disturbance, it is difficult to achieve high-performance position tracking by conventional control. Combining the advantages of non-singular terminal sliding mode and backstepping control, a backstepping terminal sliding mode control strategy is put forward in this article. First, backstepping sliding mode variable structure control method is put forward based on the basic framework of vector control of surface permanent magnet synchronous motor; second, non-singular terminal sliding mode is introduced to improve the dynamic response performance of the controller accelerating system. Simulation 1 results show that the motor position tracking control system under the backstepping terminal sliding mode variable structure control method proposed in this article has quicker system dynamic response, higher tracking accuracy and better system robust performance under external load disturbance and system parameter perturbation.
